strings.无界互联 Unbound link — Windows 桌面代理客户端: Unbound link — Windows Desktop Proxy Client
strings.窗口有边，<em>连接无界</em>:
A window has edges.
A connection doesn't.
strings.订阅自动更新、分流规则、按进程绑定线路、链式代理、断网急救——都收进这一个窗口里: Auto-updating subscriptions, routing rules, per-process routing, chained proxies, network rescue — all inside this one window, fully local. Works without writing config files, and never stands in the way if you prefer to.
strings.日常用得上的功能，都做成了看得懂的样子: Everyday features, made easy to understand
strings.不求功能堆砌，只求每一步都有明确的入口、清晰的状态和一句能看懂的说明。: Not a pile of features — every step has a clear entry point, a clear status and a plain-language explanation.
strings.一条链接导入订阅，卡片上直接看到用量与到期时间；可设定每 1～24 小时自动拉取: Import a subscription with a single link and see usage and expiry right on the card. Set auto-update every 1–24 hours; when an update finishes, the config reloads automatically and a system notification is sent.
strings.让浏览器走一条线、游戏走另一条线。按进程名或完整路径绑定，选两条以上线路自动组成: Send your browser through one line and your games through another. Bind by process name or full path; picking two or more lines forms a load-balance group automatically, with round-robin or session-persistent policies.
strings.给受限节点指定一个前置代理，让流量先经中转再出去。界面上点节点卡片上的链式按钮即: Assign a front proxy to a restricted node so traffic goes through the relay first. Set it with the chain button on the node card; latency is simply the sum of both hops.
strings.不想动订阅原文时，用 Merge 片段深度覆盖任意配置项；需要批量改写时用内置: When you don't want to touch the original subscription, deep-override any config field with a Merge snippet. For bulk edits, the built-in QuickJS engine runs one extension script — rename nodes, add rules, all from a dialog.
strings.实时网速、当前节点延迟、活跃连接数悬在桌面上。3 档尺寸、3 种版式、7 套配色: Live speed, current node latency and active connections stay on your desktop. 3 sizes, 3 layouts, 7 color themes — with mouse pass-through and drag anywhere.
strings.代理异常退出导致浏览器打不开页面时，先在网络体检里定位问题，再一键重置系统代理、: When the proxy exits unexpectedly and your browser can't open pages, Diagnostics pinpoints the problem first, then one click resets the system proxy and flushes the DNS cache, with an automatic re-check.
strings.订阅、覆写、脚本，三层各管各的: Subscriptions, overrides, scripts — three layers, each minding its own business
strings.订阅保持原始状态随订阅源更新，你的个性化改动放在独立文件里，互不覆盖——换订阅、: Subscriptions stay pristine and follow upstream updates while your personal changes live in separate files — no overwriting. Swap subscriptions or providers without reconfiguring everything.
strings.<b>订阅管理</b>：支持 http/https 订阅链接，可拖动排序、重命名: Profiles: http/https subscription links, drag to reorder, rename, generate a QR code to share with your phone, and view live usage.
strings.<b>Merge 覆写</b>：写几行片段即可覆盖订阅里的字段（端口、模式等应用: Merge override: a few lines override fields in the subscription (except app-level settings such as port and mode), deeply merged recursively when the runtime config is generated.
strings.<b>扩展脚本</b>：内置 QuickJS 引擎，一个 <code>main(: Extension script: built-in QuickJS engine — one main(config) function batch-renames nodes and adds or removes rules.
strings.<b>运行时配置</b>：端口、密钥、模式等应用级字段由客户端注入，不会被订阅覆: Runtime config: app-level fields such as port, secret and mode are injected by the client and never overridden by subscriptions; config changes hot-reload automatically — no manual core restart.
strings.<a class=\"btn btn-ghost\" href=\"./docs: How to use Profiles →
strings.让不同的应用，各走各的线路: Let every app take its own route
strings.不必为了一个游戏把全局都切走。按进程名或完整路径绑定线路，其余流量继续交给规则处: No need to switch everything to global for one game. Bind lines by process name or full path; all other traffic keeps following the rules.
strings.<b>选得省事</b>：可以直接从「正在联网的进程」里挑，带应用图标，不用记 e: Easy to pick: choose straight from processes currently using the network, with app icons — no need to remember exe names.
strings.<b>绑得灵活</b>：一条线路就直连该组；两条以上自动生成聚合组，多种线路一起: Flexible binding: one line goes directly to that group; two or more lines form a load-balance group so multiple lines serve the same app together.
strings.<b>聚合有策略</b>：轮询分散让多连接铺开到各线路，会话保持让同一会话固定走: Load-balance policies: round-robin spreads connections across lines; session-persistent keeps a session on one line.
strings.<b>看得见效果</b>：绑定列表实时显示该应用当前的上下行速率，是否生效一眼可: Visible results: the binding list shows the app's live up/down speed — one glance tells whether it's working.
strings.<a class=\"btn btn-ghost\" href=\"./docs: How to set up App Routing →
strings.先告诉你是哪里不对，再帮你修好: First it tells you what's wrong, then it helps you fix it
strings.网络体检会依次检查 11 项：内核状态、端口监听、系统代理、DNS 解析、DNS: Diagnostics runs 11 checks in order: core status, port listening, system proxy, DNS resolution, DNS takeover, direct exit, proxy exit, WebRTC leaks, current node, direct GitHub access and config loading. Each check gives a conclusion and a suggested next step.
strings.重置系统代理 + 刷新 DNS 缓存，两项都不需要管理员权限，点完立即生效——足: Reset the system proxy and flush the DNS cache — neither needs admin rights and both take effect instantly, enough to fix the most common failure: "browser can't open pages after the proxy exits".
strings.系统代理残留、DNS 服务器被改成 0.0.0.0、hosts 文件异常、网络协: Leftover system proxy settings, DNS servers set to 0.0.0.0, abnormal hosts files, damaged network stacks — each has its own repair button; operations needing admin rights are clearly marked and go through UAC elevation.
strings.下载后 3 分钟就能用上: Up and running 3 minutes after download
strings.安装包已内含 mihomo 内核与 TUN 驱动，导入订阅即可开始。: The installer already bundles the mihomo core and TUN driver — import your subscription and you're ready to go.
strings.Windows 桌面代理客户端。基于 mihomo 内核，订阅、分流、观测与急救: Windows desktop proxy client. Built on the mihomo core, with subscriptions, routing, monitoring and rescue all in one window.
strings.本软件仅提供网络代理的本地管理能力，请遵守当地法律法规与相关服务条款。: This software only provides local management for network proxying. Please comply with your local laws, regulations and the relevant terms of service.
strings.无界互联（Unbound link）是一款基于 mihomo 内核的 Windo: Unbound link is a Windows desktop proxy client based on the mihomo core, with subscription management, routing rules, per-app process binding, chained proxies and network rescue — a clean interface that works out of the box.
strings.十一个页面，覆盖从部署到排障的全过程: Eleven pages covering everything from setup to troubleshooting
strings.左侧菜单按使用场景分成三组：先在「代理与分流」配好线路，再到「观测与数据」看清运: The left menu is grouped by usage: set up routes in "Proxy & Routing" first, see what is happening in "Monitoring & Data", and let "Stability & Troubleshooting" handle the unexpected.
strings.把「流量走哪条线」这件事拆成三层：订阅决定有哪些线路，规则决定默认怎么走，应用分: "Which line does traffic take" splits into three layers: your subscriptions define the available lines, rules decide the default route, and App Routing decides the exceptions.
strings.支持 http/https 订阅链接导入；卡片可拖动排序、重命名、生成二维码分享: Supports http/https subscription links; cards can be dragged to reorder, renamed, shared to your phone as a QR code, and usage info refreshed with one click. Multiple subscriptions can be enabled at once, and single nodes can be imported from node links; set an hourly auto-update interval — after an update the config reloads automatically and a system notification is sent, and you can optionally auto-test and switch to the fastest node after updates; usage alerts fire once each when the threshold is reached, expiry nears, or the subscription has expired; before every update the old content is archived automatically, so you can roll back anytime.
strings.左右分栏：左边按分组与订阅来源浏览，右边节点卡片网格。支持单节点测延迟、下载测速: Split view: browse by group and subscription source on the left, a node card grid on the right. Supports latency tests for a single node, download speed tests (the original node is restored automatically afterwards), test all, sorting by latency/name, region filters and favorites-only. One click hides timed-out nodes at the top; card columns support 1–4 or auto-fit; with Node health monitoring on, each card also carries a latency trend line (red dots mark failed tests), and with Automatic failover on a current node that keeps failing tests also gets switched away automatically. Switch freely between the list and map views — the map aggregates nodes into dots by region, sized by count and colored by latency; click a dot to drill into that region.
strings.按进程名或完整路径把应用绑定到指定线路，可直接从正在联网的进程里挑选。选两条以上: Bind apps to specific lines by process name or full path, picking directly from processes currently using the network. Selecting two or more lines forms a group automatically, with round-robin or session-persistent policies; the list shows each app's live speed.
strings.为某个节点指定前置代理，流量先经中转再出去，适合受限节点。节点卡片上有链式标记，: Assign a front proxy to a node so traffic first goes through the relay — ideal for restricted nodes. A chain badge on the node card shows which front proxy is used on hover.
strings.把本机端口转发到远端目标：内核在本地监听指定端口，经指定出口（代理组、节点或按规: Forward a local port to a remote target: the core listens locally on the given port and forwards through a chosen exit (proxy group, node or rule-based routing) to the target host — handy for mapping remote intranet services to your machine. Supports TCP / UDP / mixed protocols.
strings.在实时连接页右键任意连接，选「此域名直连」或「此域名走指定线路」，立刻生成一条插: Right-click any connection on the Connections page and choose "direct for this domain" or "route this domain through a chosen line" — a domain rule is inserted at the very top and takes effect immediately, with no file edits or restarts.
strings.规则列表、自定义规则、规则集、命中统计四个页签，可在规则页直接增删改并排序自定义: Four tabs: Rules, Custom rules, Rule sets and Hit statistics, where you can add, edit, reorder and delete your own rules right in the page — on save they are injected at the very top of the runtime config. Hit stats are sampled every 15 seconds and accumulated to disk — surviving restarts — so you can tell whether a rule is really doing its job.
strings.三种让流量走代理的方式，怎么选: Three ways to proxy traffic — how to choose
strings.支持系统代理的程序（浏览器、多数桌面软件）: Apps that honor the system proxy (browsers, most desktop software)
strings.全部流量，含不认系统代理的程序: All traffic, including apps that ignore the system proxy
strings.游戏、命令行工具、全局接管: Games, command-line tools, full network takeover
strings.只想让个别应用走指定线路: Route only individual apps through chosen lines
strings.代理的痛点往往是「不知道现在发生了什么」。所以每个状态都有对应的地方可看。: The pain with proxies is often "not knowing what's happening right now". That's why every status has somewhere to look.
strings.内核状态、版本、内存占用与运行时长，累计上下行与活跃连接数，实时流量曲线；并可直: Core status, version, memory usage and uptime; total up/down traffic and active connections; a live traffic chart. You can also switch each proxy group's current node right on the Dashboard.
strings.明细视图按连接逐行展示主机、进程、目标地址、命中规则、链路与实时速率；聚合视图按: The detail view lists host, process, destination, matched rule, chain and live speed for each connection; the aggregated view groups connection counts by domain. Right-click to create a quick rule for a domain or copy the domain, destination address or process path.
strings.按日记录上下行用量，可切换近 7 天 / 近 30 天 / 近 90 天 / 全: Records daily up/down usage with 7-day / 30-day / 90-day / all-time views, plus a trend chart and a daily detail table; a Node traffic panel groups traffic by the exit node each connection finally leaves through (direct traffic is recorded as DIRECT), so you can see how much each line has used, with a one-click stats reset. Data is continuously persisted and survives restarts.
strings.内核日志与应用层日志同屏呈现，应用层日志带 <code>[无界互联]</code: Core logs and app logs shown on one screen; app logs carry a [Unbound link] prefix for easy distinction. Filter by Debug / Info / Warning / Error. Logs are also written to logs\app.log with automatic rotation and expiry cleanup.
strings.实时网速、当前节点延迟、活跃连接数、今日流量与代理状态悬在桌面。3 档尺寸、3: Live speed, current node latency, active connections, today's traffic and proxy status on your desktop. 3 sizes, 3 layouts, 7 color themes, adjustable opacity, mouse pass-through and automatically remembered position.
strings.托盘图标随代理状态三态切换（常规 / 系统代理 / TUN），三态均可替换为自己: The tray icon switches between three states with the proxy status (normal / system proxy / TUN), and each state can be replaced with your own PNG icon. Right-click opens a quick panel to toggle the system proxy or TUN, see speed or open the main window without launching the full app. Click the "node" or "group" row and a standalone node picker pops up beside it: browse by group, click to switch.
strings.该接管系统的部分接管系统，该留在本机的部分留在本机。: Take over what belongs to the system; keep local what belongs to the machine.
strings.一键写入或还原 Windows Internet 设置；开启「网络环境」后，还能: One click writes or restores Windows Internet settings; with "Network environment" on, the system proxy and mode also switch automatically by Wi-Fi name (e.g. on at home, off at the office). TUN takes over all traffic at the network layer through a virtual adapter, with Mixed / Gvisor / System stacks to choose from. When admin rights are needed, a UAC prompt guides the elevation. If Store apps can't reach the local proxy due to the loopback restriction, the UWP App Tool lifts it with one click.
strings.可自定义 DNS 服务器（含备用 DNS 与静态 Hosts）覆盖订阅配置，可选: Custom DNS servers (including fallback DNS and static Hosts) can override the subscription's settings, with optional fake-ip acceleration; enabling "allow LAN" lets phones, tablets and other devices on the same subnet use the local proxy directly. The Share to phone button on the same row then shows a QR code — set the phone's Wi-Fi manual proxy as prompted.
strings.内置 MetaCubeXD 面板，首次打开自动下载托管，地址 <code>htt: The built-in MetaCubeXD dashboard downloads and hosts itself on first open at http://127.0.0.1:9090/ui/; with LAN enabled, an address for other devices to access the dashboard is also shown.
strings.默认 <code>Ctrl+Shift+P</code> 切换系统代理、<cod: Defaults: Ctrl+Shift+P toggles the system proxy, Ctrl+Shift+T toggles TUN, Ctrl+Shift+U shows the main window, Ctrl+Shift+O toggles the floating window and Ctrl+Shift+M switches the proxy mode. "Update all subscriptions" and "Restart core" can be recorded separately — all shortcuts are customizable or resettable to default.
strings.按 <code>Ctrl+K</code> 在任意页面呼出：跳转页面与设置分类、: Press Ctrl+K to bring it up on any page: jump to pages and settings categories, run actions like starting / stopping the core or switching modes, update and toggle subscriptions, check for updates and restore backups, use network rescue, and search and switch nodes — all filterable by keyword and fully keyboard-driven.
strings.开机自启与单实例: Launch at startup and single instance
strings.可设置开机自动运行；程序保证单实例运行，重复启动时唤出已有窗口，不会出现两个内核: Optionally run at startup; the app is single-instance, so launching it again brings up the existing window — no two cores fighting over ports. Closing the main window minimizes to the tray instead of exiting. On a fresh install, the first launch opens a four-step guide that walks you through importing a subscription and recommended settings.
strings.深色 / 浅色 / 跟随系统三档，实时切换；品牌色、次要色、文本色、语义色、界面: Dark / light / follow-system modes with instant switching; brand color, secondary color, text color, semantic colors, UI font and custom CSS are all adjustable. The flat design uses black primary buttons and restrained semantic colors — blue for in-progress, green for normal, amber for pending, red for errors.
strings.既照顾不想碰配置的人，也照顾想精细控制的人: For those who don't want to touch configs — and those who do
strings.订阅保持原始、你的改动单独存一份，两者在生成运行时配置时才合并——这意味着订阅源: Subscriptions stay pristine while your changes live in a separate file; the two merge only when the runtime config is generated — meaning subscription updates never overwrite your personal settings.
strings.<b>Merge 覆写</b>：写几行 YAML 片段即可覆盖订阅里的字段（端口: Merge override: a few lines of YAML override fields in the subscription (app-level settings such as port and mode are handled by the client), deeply merged recursively.
strings.<b>扩展脚本</b>：内置 QuickJS，一个 <code>main(con: Extension script: built-in QuickJS — one main(config) function batch-renames nodes and adds or removes rules.
strings.<b>节点整理</b>：按关键词过滤节点、按规则批量重命名（含统一前后缀），并同: Node Cleanup: filter nodes by keyword and batch-rename them by rules (with common prefixes/suffixes), rewriting references in proxy groups and rules to match — preview before enabling.
strings.<b>应用级设置注入</b>：端口、控制密钥、模式等字段由客户端负责写入，不会被: App-level settings injection: fields such as port, control secret and mode are written by the client and never overridden by subscription content.
strings.<b>配置热重载</b>：切换节点、改端口、改 DNS 后自动应用，不中断已有连: Config hot reload: switching nodes, changing ports or DNS applies automatically without interrupting existing connections.
strings.<b>原子写入</b>：运行时配置先写临时文件再改名，避免内核读到半截文件。: Atomic writes: the runtime config is written to a temp file first, then renamed, so the core never reads a half-written file.
strings.<b>配置快照</b>：每次生成运行配置前自动留档旧版本（保留最近 10 份），: Config snapshots: before each runtime config is generated the previous version is archived automatically (the latest 10 are kept); if the core won't start, roll back to the last working version in one click — an emergency fallback.
strings.把设置、订阅、Merge 配置与内核版本导出为一个 JSON 文件；换电脑或重装: Export settings, subscriptions, Merge config and the core version into a single JSON file; after switching computers or reinstalling, import it with one click under Settings → Maintenance to restore everything. "Export diagnostics" packages versions, settings, config and recent logs into a ZIP (sensitive fields redacted) to make reporting issues easier.
strings.「设置 → 维护 → 内核更新」可检查并获取新版本内核，下载完成后自动替换，无需: Settings → Maintenance → Core update checks for and fetches new core versions, replacing the current one automatically after download — no manual file handling.
strings.内核异常退出时自动拉起，并带有防抖动限制：短时间内反复崩溃不会陷入无限重启，而是: Automatically restarts the core if it exits unexpectedly, with debounce protection: repeated crashes in a short time won't cause an infinite restart loop — they're faithfully recorded in Logs instead.
strings.代理软件出问题时最难受的是不知道问题在哪。这里把「诊断」和「修复」拆成了两步。: The worst part of proxy trouble is not knowing where the problem is. So diagnosis and repair are split into two steps.
strings.内核状态、端口监听、系统代理、DNS 解析、DNS 接管、直连出口、代理出口、W: Core status, port listening, system proxy, DNS resolution, DNS takeover, direct exit, proxy exit, WebRTC leaks, current node, direct GitHub access and config loading. Each gives a conclusion, and abnormal items come with suggestions.
strings.针对系统代理残留、DNS 解析失败、DNS 服务器被改写、hosts 文件异常、: For five classes of problems — leftover system proxy settings, DNS resolution failures, rewritten DNS servers, abnormal hosts files and damaged network stacks — each is detected with a matching repair button and an automatic re-check afterwards.
strings.经当前出口检测 18 项服务的可用性，覆盖 Netflix、Disney+ 等流: Checks 18 services through the current exit — streaming such as Netflix and Disney+, AI services such as ChatGPT and Claude, and China-side platforms such as Bilibili — and reports one of four states with a note: Unlocked / Partial / Blocked / Failed. Switch the exit node on the page itself to pick a route and retest right away.
strings.「一键急救」里的重置系统代理与刷新 DNS 缓存都不需要管理员权限，随时可用；只: In the one-click rescue, resetting the system proxy and flushing the DNS cache need no admin rights and are always available; only resetting DNS servers, restoring the hosts file and resetting the network stack require UAC elevation, clearly marked in the UI.
strings.准备好试一下了吗: Ready to give it a try
strings.下载安装包，导入订阅，三分钟就能跑起来。: Download the installer, import your subscription, and you're up and running in three minutes.
strings.无界互联功能总览：订阅管理、分流规则、应用级进程绑定、链式代理、实时连接观测、流: Unbound link features: subscription management, routing rules, per-app process binding, chained proxies, live connection monitoring, traffic statistics, desktop floating window, system tray, TUN mode, Diagnostics and network rescue.
strings.一个安装包，装完就能用: One installer, ready when it's done
strings.mihomo 内核与 TUN 驱动随包分发，不需要你另外下载内核、放置文件或配置: The mihomo core and TUN driver ship inside the package — no separate core downloads, file placement or environment variables needed.
strings.安装程序为 NSIS 打包，双击后按向导完成安装；首次启动即可添加订阅。内核对用: The installer is built with NSIS — double-click and follow the wizard. Add subscriptions on first launch. The core is transparent: the client starts, supervises and stops it.
strings.安装包内容<b>主程序 + mihomo 内核 + TUN 驱动</b>: Package contentsMain app + mihomo core + TUN driver
strings.数据存储<b>全部保存在本机</b>: Data storageAll kept on your machine
strings.请只从官方发布页获取安装包: Only get installers from the official releases page
strings.下载地址为 GitHub Releases 页面。安装包会请求网络与文件读写权限: Downloads live on the GitHub Releases page. The installer requests network and file read/write permissions — verify the source is trustworthy before installing.
strings.使用系统代理无需额外权限；使用 TUN 模式需要管理员权限，届时会弹出 UAC: The system proxy needs no extra privileges; TUN mode requires admin rights and will show a UAC prompt.
strings.如果电脑上已装其他使用相同内核的客户端，请先退出其中之一，避免控制端口冲突。: If another client using the same core is installed on the machine, exit one of them first to avoid control port conflicts.
strings.默认占用端口：混合代理 <code>7890</code>、控制接口 <code: Default ports: mixed proxy 7890, control API 9090 — changeable in Settings.
strings.先到「订阅管理」添加订阅，再打开卡片上的启用开关。: Add a subscription under Profiles first, then flip the enable switch on its card.
strings.在「设置 → 常规 → 系统集成」打开系统代理。: Turn on the system proxy under Settings → General → System integration.
strings.回「仪表盘」确认内核运行中、节点有延迟数值。: Return to the Dashboard to confirm the core is running and nodes show latency values.
strings.三步装好，五步用起来: Three steps to install, five to be productive
strings.打开官方发布页，在最新版本中下载 Windows 安装包（文件名形如 <code: Open the official releases page and download the Windows installer from the latest release (file names look like Unboundlink_x.x.x_x64-setup.exe).
strings.双击安装包，选择安装位置后一路下一步即可。建议使用默认安装目录，避免放在含中文或: Double-click the installer, choose a location and click Next through the wizard. Stick to the default directory — avoid paths with Chinese or special characters.
strings.从开始菜单或桌面图标启动。若检测到历史版本的数据目录，客户端会自动迁移旧设置与订: Launch it from the Start menu or desktop icon. If a previous version's data directory is found, settings and subscriptions migrate automatically — no manual file copying.

strings.「订阅管理」→「添加订阅」→ 粘贴 http/https 订阅链接 → 确定；回: Profiles → Add subscription → paste the http/https link → OK; back on the card flip the enable switch (multiple subscriptions can be on at once).
strings.「设置 → 常规 → 系统集成」打开「系统代理」，然后到「仪表盘」确认下载、上传: Enable the system proxy under Settings → General → System integration, then check the Dashboard — download and upload figures should start moving.

strings.安装包自带的 WebView2 运行环境，如系统缺失会由安装程序引导安装: WebView2 ships with the installer; if missing, the setup guides you through installing it
strings.随安装包分发，无需另行下载: Bundled with the installer, no separate download needed

strings.配置、订阅与内核工作目录位于 <code>%APPDATA%\\com.unbo: Configs, subscriptions and the core's working directory live under %APPDATA%\com.unboundlink.desktop, containing settings, the subscription index and originals, Merge overrides, extension scripts, the generated runtime config, dashboard files, rule hit statistics and traffic history.
strings.在「设置 → 关于」里可以直接查看并复制数据目录路径。: View and copy the data directory path under Settings → About.
strings.换电脑前用「设置 → 维护 → 备份与恢复 → 导出备份」导出一个 JSON 文: Before switching computers, use Settings → Maintenance → Backup and restore → Export backup to get a JSON file; import it in the new environment to restore settings, subscriptions, Merge config and core version records.
strings.卸载程序不会自动删除数据目录；如需彻底清理，卸载后手动删除上述目录即可。: Uninstalling doesn't delete the data directory; to clean up completely, delete the directory manually after uninstalling.

strings.装不上、连不上、不知道某个开关在哪——这些都在手册里写清楚了，这里挑出最常被问到: Installation failures, connection issues, "where is that switch" — the guide covers them all; this page gathers the most frequently asked questions.
strings.无界互联和 Clash 系列客户端是什么关系？: How does Unbound link relate to Clash-based clients?
strings.无界互联是一个 Windows 桌面客户端，网络能力全部来自 <b>mihomo: Unbound link is a Windows desktop client whose networking power comes entirely from the mihomo core (the successor of the Clash Meta line) — it implements no proxy protocols itself. Its job is subscription management, runtime config generation, core lifecycle and supervision, and observing and controlling the core through its API.
strings.需要自己下载和放置内核吗？: Do I need to download and place the core myself?
strings.不需要。内核（mihomo）与 TUN 驱动随安装包一起分发，由客户端负责启动和: No. The core (mihomo) and TUN driver ship with the installer, and the client starts and stops them. You don't edit config files by hand either — the runtime config is generated by the client from your subscription and settings.
strings.内核本身也可以在「设置 → 维护 → 内核更新」里检查并更新到新版本。: The core itself can be checked and updated under Settings → Maintenance → Core update.
strings.目前仅支持 Windows 10 / 11 64 位。部分功能（系统代理写入、T: Currently only 64-bit Windows 10 / 11. Some features (system proxy writes, the TUN virtual adapter, the tray and UAC elevation) rely on Windows capabilities.
strings.从哪里获取订阅？: Where do I get a subscription?
strings.订阅由你自己的服务商提供，客户端不附带也不代购任何订阅。拿到形如 <code>h: Subscriptions come from your own provider — the client bundles none and resells none. Once you have a link like https://…, paste it into Profiles → Add subscription.
strings.可以导入并保留多个订阅，卡片可拖动排序。每个订阅的启用开关独立控制，可以同时启用: You can import and keep multiple subscriptions, and drag cards to reorder them. Each subscription has its own enable switch — several can be on at once: the first enabled subscription supplies the base config (port / DNS / mode), while the others merge in their nodes, proxy groups and rules; the effective order follows the list from top to bottom. Changing what's enabled regenerates the runtime config.
strings.开了系统代理，为什么有些软件还是不走代理？: The system proxy is on — why do some apps still bypass it?
strings.这是系统代理的固有局限：只有读取 Windows Internet 设置的程序（: That's the inherent limitation of system proxies: only programs that read Windows Internet settings (browsers, most desktop software) use it. Games, some command-line tools and apps with their own network stack ignore this setting.
strings.两种解决办法：开启 <b>TUN 模式</b>（虚拟网卡在网络层接管全部流量，需: Two fixes: enable TUN mode (the virtual adapter takes over all traffic at the network layer; admin rights required), or bind the process to a chosen line with App Routing.
strings.Microsoft Store 安装的应用连不上网怎么办？: Apps from the Microsoft Store can't reach the network — what should I do?
Windows blocks Store apps from accessing local addresses (127.0.0.1) by default, so they can't use the local proxy directly — the app shows no connectivity, spinning forever.
strings.到「设置 → 工具 → UWP 应用工具 → 管理应用」，为它打开开关解除回环限: Go to Settings → Tools → UWP App Tool → Manage apps and flip the switch to lift the loopback restriction; this needs admin rights — if it fails, restart the app as administrator and try again.
strings.系统代理、TUN 模式、应用分流，到底该用哪个？: System proxy, TUN mode or App Routing — which should I use?
strings.<b>系统代理</b>：覆盖浏览器等大多数软件，不需要额外权限，日常首选。: System proxy: covers browsers and most software, needs no extra privileges — the everyday first choice.
strings.<b>TUN 模式</b>：覆盖全部流量，包括不认系统代理的程序；需要管理员权限: TUN mode: covers all traffic, including apps that ignore the system proxy; requires admin rights.
strings.<b>应用分流</b>：只影响被绑定的进程，用来给个别应用指定专门线路。: App Routing: affects only bound processes — for singling out individual apps onto dedicated lines.
strings.三者可以同时开启，互不冲突。: All three can be enabled at the same time without conflict.
strings.运行模式里的「规则」「全局」「直连」有什么区别？: What's the difference between Rule, Global and Direct modes?
strings.<b>规则</b>按订阅与你自己添加的规则决定每条流量走哪条线，是日常使用的模式: Rule decides each connection's path from the subscription and your own rules — the everyday mode; Global ignores rules and sends everything through the selected exit; Direct bypasses the proxy entirely.
strings.在「设置 → 网络 → 运行模式」切换。需要注意：切换到「全局」或「直连」后，规: Switch under Settings → Network → Mode. Note: in Global or Direct mode, rules in the rule list no longer take effect.
strings.快捷规则和订阅里的规则冲突时，谁生效？: Quick rules vs. subscription rules — which wins?
strings.快捷规则优先。你在「实时连接」页右键创建的域名规则会被插入到规则列表的最前面，因: Quick rules. Domain rules you create by right-clicking on the Connections page are inserted at the very top of the rule list, so they match before subscription rules and take effect immediately — no core restart needed.
strings.节点显示全部超时怎么办？: All nodes show as timed out — what now?
strings.按顺序排查：① 在「代理节点」页点「全部测速」确认最新延迟；② 在「订阅管理」页: Check in order: ① On the Proxies page click "Test all" for the latest latencies; ② On the Profiles page click "Traffic" on the card to refresh usage info and confirm the subscription hasn't expired; ③ Click "Update" to re-fetch the subscription; ④ Check the "direct exit / proxy exit" and "current node" conclusions in Diagnostics.
strings.切换节点会让已有连接断开吗？: Does switching nodes drop existing connections?
strings.切换节点、修改 DNS 或端口这类改动会通过热重载应用到内核，不会重启内核进程本: Switching nodes or changing DNS/ports applies to the core via hot reload — the core process itself is not restarted. Connections already in flight may be re-established because the exit changed; that's normal proxy behavior.
strings.为什么有些操作要求管理员权限？: Why do some operations require admin rights?
strings.需要改动系统级设置的操作会要求管理员权限：开启 TUN 模式、重置 DNS 服务: Operations that modify system-level settings require admin rights: enabling TUN mode, resetting DNS servers, restoring the hosts file and resetting the network stack. The client marks them clearly in the UI and elevates via UAC when executed — never silently.
strings.而「一键急救」里的重置系统代理与刷新 DNS 缓存不需要管理员权限，随时可以点。: Resetting the system proxy and flushing the DNS cache in one-click rescue need no admin rights and are always available.
strings.软件会收集或上传我的数据吗？: Does the software collect or upload my data?
strings.不需要账号，也不做数据上报。设置、订阅、统计与日志全部保存在本机的数据目录 <c: No account required, no telemetry. Settings, subscriptions, statistics and logs all live in the local data directory %APPDATA%\com.unboundlink.desktop.
strings.程序产生的对外网络请求只有三类：拉取你的订阅链接、检查与获取内核更新、以及网络体: The app makes only three kinds of outbound requests: fetching your subscription links, checking for and downloading core updates, and probe requests during Diagnostics and speed tests (e.g., 204 check endpoints and your own nodes).
strings.换电脑或重装系统，怎么把配置带走？: Switching computers or reinstalling — how do I keep my setup?
strings.「设置 → 维护 → 备份与恢复 → 导出备份」，会把设置、订阅、Merge 配: Settings → Maintenance → Backup and restore → Export backup produces a JSON file with your settings, subscriptions, Merge config and core version. Install in the new environment and click "Import backup" to restore (this overwrites current settings and subscriptions).
strings.想反馈问题，怎么提供信息最有用？: I want to report a problem — what information helps most?
strings.「设置 → 维护 → 备份与恢复 → 导出诊断信息」会生成一个 ZIP 包，内含: Settings → Maintenance → Backup and restore → Export diagnostics produces a ZIP with app and core versions, current settings, runtime config and recent logs — secrets and other sensitive fields are redacted automatically, so you can attach it directly to your report.
strings.卸载后浏览器打不开网页了？: After uninstalling, my browser can't open pages?
strings.说明卸载时系统代理仍处于开启状态，浏览器还在指向本机的代理端口。处理方式：重新安: That means the system proxy was still on at uninstall time and the browser is still pointing at the local proxy port. Fix: reinstall and click "One-click rescue" in Diagnostics → Network rescue (reset system proxy + flush DNS cache), or clear the proxy server in Windows Internet Options → Connections → LAN settings.
strings.以后卸载前，先在「设置 → 系统 → 系统代理」关闭「系统代理」即可。: In the future, turn off the system proxy under Settings → System → System proxy before uninstalling.
strings.卸载会删除我的设置和订阅吗？: Will uninstalling delete my settings and subscriptions?
strings.不会。卸载程序只移除程序文件，数据目录会保留。如果需要彻底清理，手动删除 <co: No. The uninstaller only removes program files; the data directory stays. To clean up completely, delete %APPDATA%\com.unboundlink.desktop manually.
strings.默认占用哪些端口？被占用怎么办？: Which ports are used by default? What if they're taken?
strings.默认混合代理端口为 <code>7890</code>，控制接口端口为 <cod: The default mixed proxy port is 7890 and the control API port is 9090. The "port listening" check in Diagnostics tells you whether the ports are properly listened on or taken by another program. Change them under Settings → Network → Ports and mode; the core restarts automatically after changes.
strings.「下载测速」为什么只测 10 秒，还临时换了节点？: Why does the download speed test run only about 10 seconds — and switch nodes temporarily?
strings.节点卡片上的仪表图标是下载测速，需要真实下载一段时间才能反映带宽，因此固定约 1: The gauge icon on a node card runs a download speed test; reflecting real bandwidth takes actual downloading, hence roughly 10 seconds. The test temporarily switches the exit to that node and restores the previously selected node when done. Results are cleared automatically after about 10 minutes so stale data doesn't mislead.
strings.日志里为什么有两套来源？: Why do the logs have two sources?
strings.内核自身产生的日志（连接、规则匹配等）来自内核的实时通道；客户端自身的操作日志（: Logs from the core itself (connections, rule matching, etc.) come over the core's live channel; the client's own operation logs (subscription updates, config reloads, core start/stop, etc.) carry a [Unbound link] prefix. Both appear together in time order on the Logs page, and level filters apply to both.
strings.关闭窗口后程序去哪了？: Where does the app go when I close the window?
strings.默认「关闭时最小化到托盘」是开启的，点关闭按钮只是隐藏窗口，代理仍在运行。从托盘: By default "minimize to tray on close" is on — the close button only hides the window and the proxy keeps running. Right-click the tray icon to reopen the main window or exit completely. This behavior can be changed under Settings → System → Tray and watchdog.
strings.悬浮窗怎么调样式，会不会挡住鼠标操作？: How do I customize the floating window — and will it block mouse clicks?
strings.悬浮窗支持 3 档尺寸、3 种版式（卡片 / 胶囊 / 仪表）和 7 套配色，可: The floating window offers 3 sizes, 3 layouts (card / capsule / gauge) and 7 color themes; latency, connection count, traffic chart, today's traffic and proxy status can each be toggled, and opacity adjusted. If clicks bother you, enable "mouse pass-through" under Settings → System → Tray and watchdog.
strings.默认五个全局快捷键：<code>Ctrl+Shift+P</code> 切换系统: Five global shortcuts by default: Ctrl+Shift+P toggles the system proxy, Ctrl+Shift+T toggles TUN mode, Ctrl+Shift+U shows the main window, Ctrl+Shift+O toggles the traffic floating window and Ctrl+Shift+M cycles the proxy mode (Rule → Global → Direct). "Update all subscriptions" and "Restart core" are unbound by default and can be recorded. Find them under Settings → System → Global shortcuts; record your own or reset to defaults.
strings.先看手册的 <a href=\"./docs/troubleshooting.h: Check the Troubleshooting and Diagnostics chapters of the guide first; if that doesn't help, open an issue in the repository — including error lines from the Logs page and the Diagnostics conclusions speeds up the investigation.
strings.完整手册按界面逐页讲解，包含每个开关的位置与默认值。: The full guide walks through every screen, including each switch's location and default value.
strings.无界互联 Unbound link 常见问题：内核与订阅、是否需要管理员权限、系: Unbound link FAQ: the core and subscriptions, admin rights, system proxy vs. TUN, data and privacy, backup and migration, uninstall notes and more.
strings.只记录用户能感知的变化：新增了什么、改进了什么、修好了什么。: Only user-visible changes are recorded: what's new, what's improved, what's fixed.
strings.相比首个公开版本，这一版把界面扩展到 13 种语言，新增解锁测试与云备份、首次启: Compared with the first public release, this version expands the UI to 13 languages, adds Unlock Test and cloud backup, first-run onboarding, config snapshots and subscription version history, node health monitoring and the world map, and upgrades chained proxies, routing rules, the tray panel and Settings. Below is the full feature list for the current version.
strings.订阅管理：http/https 订阅导入、拖动排序、编辑订阅信息、二维码分享、用: Profiles: http/https subscription import, drag to reorder, edit subscription info, QR-code sharing, usage refresh, automatic archiving before updates with rollback to any version (with node and rule count change badges), and hourly auto-update.
strings.订阅用量提醒：流量达到阈值（默认 80%）、临近到期（默认剩余 3 天）或已过期: Profile usage alerts: sends a system notification when used traffic reaches the threshold (default 80%), remaining days run low (default 3 days left) or the subscription has expired, each tier firing once; after renewal or a plan reset the alerts reset and can fire again.
strings.机场官网：下载订阅时自动识别机场官网地址，卡片上一键用浏览器打开；识别不到时可在: Provider website: auto-detected when a subscription is downloaded and opened in your browser with one click from the card; if it isn't detected, enter it manually in the Edit dialog — manual entries are never overwritten. The dot beside the globe icon shows website reachability (green = reachable, red = unreachable); click it to re-check.
strings.多订阅同时启用：可同时启用多个订阅，第一个启用的提供端口 / DNS / 模式等: Multiple subscriptions at once: enable several subscriptions together — the first enabled one provides base settings (port / DNS / mode), while others merge in their nodes, proxy groups and rules; the effective order follows the list from top to bottom.
strings.本地配置导入：选择本地 YAML 文件作为订阅加入列表，带「本地」标签、不参与远: Local config import: pick a local YAML file as a subscription in the list, tagged "Local" and excluded from remote updates.
strings.手动节点：从节点链接导入单个节点（ss / vmess / vless / tr: Manual Nodes: import single nodes from node links (ss / vmess / vless / trojan / hysteria2 / tuic / socks5 / http); they merge into a proxy group of the same name when the config is generated.
strings.代理节点：分组与订阅来源浏览、单节点测延迟、下载测速、全部测速、按延迟或名称排序: Proxies: browse by group and subscription source, single-node latency test, download speed test, test all, sort by latency or name, region filter and favorites-only; one click hides timed-out nodes, card columns support 1–4 or auto-fit; switch between list and map views at any time, where the map aggregates nodes into region dots, sized by count and colored by latency — click a dot to drill into that region.
strings.自动延迟检测：按设定间隔（1-1440 分钟）自动为节点组测延迟，保持延迟数据新: Auto latency testing: automatically tests node groups at a set interval (1–1440 minutes) to keep latency data fresh.
strings.节点健康监控：滚动记录各节点延迟历史，在节点卡片上绘制延迟趋势折线（红点表示测速: Node health monitoring: keeps a rolling latency history per node and draws a latency trend line on node cards (red dots mark failed tests); sends a system notification when the node in use keeps failing tests.
strings.掉线自动切换：当前节点连续测速失败时自动切换到备用节点——可指定固定目标，留空时: Automatic failover: switches to the fallback node automatically when the current node keeps failing latency tests — pick a fixed target, or leave it empty to auto-select the lowest-latency available node in the group; sends a notification suggesting a manual switch when no usable node is found.
strings.更新后自动选优：订阅更新并重载配置后，自动对主策略组测速并切换到延迟最低的节点，: Auto-optimize after update: after subscriptions finish updating and the config reloads, the main proxy group is tested automatically and the lowest-latency node becomes the current node — no more picking a node by hand after every update.
strings.应用分流：按进程名或完整路径绑定线路，可从运行中的进程里挑选；多线路自动聚合，支: App Routing: bind lines by process name or full path, pick from running processes; multiple lines aggregate automatically with round-robin or session-persistent policies.
strings.链式代理：可视化链路编辑器，支持拖拽调整中间环节、跨分组挑选节点、代理组做链首，: Chained proxy: a visual chain editor with drag-to-reorder hops, cross-group node picking and proxy groups as the chain's first hop; saved chains reload for editing, and node cards carry a chain badge with "Entry / Relay / Exit" role tags.
strings.流量隧道：把本机端口转发到远端目标（TCP / UDP / 混合），出口可选代理: Traffic tunnel: forward a local port to a remote target (TCP / UDP / mixed), with a proxy group, node or rule-based routing as the exit.
strings.快捷规则：在实时连接页右键为域名一键创建直连或指定线路规则。: Quick rules: right-click on the Connections page to create direct or line-specific rules for a domain in one click.
strings.Merge 覆写：YAML 片段与订阅配置递归深度合并。: Merge override: YAML snippets are deeply merged recursively with the subscription config.
strings.扩展脚本：内置 QuickJS 引擎，用 <code>main(config)<: Extension script: built-in QuickJS engine — use main(config) to edit the config in bulk.
strings.节点整理：按关键词过滤节点、按规则批量重命名（含统一前后缀），并同步改写代理组与: Node Cleanup: filter nodes by keyword and batch-rename them by rules (with common prefixes/suffixes), rewriting references in proxy groups and rules to match — preview the changes before enabling.
strings.运行时配置自动生成与原子写入，配置变更热重载。: Runtime config auto-generated with atomic writes; config changes hot-reload.
strings.配置快照：每次生成运行配置前自动留档旧版本（保留最近 10 份），内核起不来或配: Config snapshots: the previous runtime config is archived automatically before each generation (the latest 10 are kept); roll back to the last working version in one click when the core won't start or the config misbehaves.
strings.内核一键检查与更新（来自官方发布页）。: One-click core check and update (from the official releases page).
strings.GeoData 数据库一键更新（geoip.dat / geosite.dat: One-click GeoData database updates (geoip.dat / geosite.dat / geoip.metadb / GeoLite2-ASN.mmdb); direct downloads fall back to mirrors or the local proxy.
strings.设置、订阅、Merge 配置与内核版本的导出与导入备份。: Export and import backups of settings, subscriptions, Merge config and core version.
strings.云备份（WebDAV）：把设置、订阅、Merge 配置与扩展脚本备份到自己的网盘: Cloud Backup (WebDAV): back up settings, subscriptions, Merge overrides and extension scripts to your own cloud drive (compatible with Jianguo Cloud, Nextcloud, Synology and more); with connection test, status comparison and one-click upload or restore. The password is encrypted by the system and stored only on this machine.
strings.设置页按「页签 - 分组 - 卡片」三级重组，配置项查找更直接。: The Settings page is reorganized into three tiers — tab, group, card — making options quicker to find.

strings.内置 MetaCubeXD Web 控制面板，首次打开自动下载托管。: Built-in MetaCubeXD web dashboard, downloaded and hosted automatically on first open.

strings.界面支持 13 种语言：English、Русский、中文、فارسی、Tat: The UI supports 13 languages: English, Русский, 中文, فارسی, Tatar, Bahasa Indonesia, العربية, 한국어, Türkçe, Deutsch, Español, 日本語 and 繁體中文 — switching takes effect immediately.

strings.在「代理节点」页点工具区的「链式代理规则」，打开链路编辑器：左侧列出已保存的链路: On the Proxies page click "Chained proxy rules" in the toolbar to open the chain editor: saved chains on the left; on the right, build a chain by picking hops from all candidates, with drag-to-reorder, insert-between-hops, region filters and pinned favorites — each candidate shows recent latency, and a proxy group can only be the first hop. strings.让不同的应用走不同的线路：把浏览器、游戏、下载工具分别绑定到合适的线路，互不干扰: Route different apps through different lines: bind your browser, games and download tools to suitable lines, each independent of the others.
strings.页面副标题就是这句话——让不同的应用走不同的线路。顶部有「启用应用分流」总开关，: The page subtitle says it: route different apps through different lines. The "Enable App Routing" master switch sits at the top, off by default, with an "Add app binding" button above the table. The master switch gates this whole page — bindings you add below only take effect once it's on. Each binding connects one app to one or more lines, after which that app's traffic follows the bound lines.
strings.所有绑定以表格形式列出，每一行就是一条绑定规则。: All bindings are listed in a table, one binding rule per row.
strings.显示图标与名称 / 进程名。: Shows the icon and name / process name.
strings.可在行内直接切换线路。多条线路时显示聚合，说明「多连接自动分布到各线路；修改请点: Switch lines directly in the row. With multiple lines it shows an aggregation note — "multiple connections are distributed across the lines; click Edit to change" — plus the latest latency for that line.
strings.该应用当前活跃连接的上行 / 下行，来自内核连接记录。: Up/down speed of the app's current active connections, from the core's connection records.
strings.开关，控制该条绑定是否生效。: Toggles whether this binding is active.
strings.编辑、移除。移除需二次确认「移除该应用绑定？」。: Edit and remove. Removal asks for confirmation: "Remove this app binding?".
strings.目标线路这一列可以直接在行内点开切换，不必每次都进弹窗；只有多条线路的聚合需要修: The Target lines column switches right in the row — no need to open the dialog every time; only aggregated multi-line targets require Edit to re-select. Live speed comes from the core's connection records and shows the app's currently active up/down traffic; it drops to zero when connections close, so it reflects this moment, not cumulative usage. To refresh line latency, use the "refresh lines" style button in the toolbar.
strings.点「添加应用绑定」打开弹窗，需要填写三部分：应用、匹配方式、目标线路。: Click "Add app binding" to open the dialog; fill in three parts: app, match method and target lines.
strings.输入进程名（如 <code>chrome.exe</code>）或完整路径（如: Enter a process name (e.g. chrome.exe) or full path (e.g. C:\Games\game.exe); a "Choose program file" button lets you browse for the exe; you can also pick directly from the list of running processes the core has seen making network connections, complete with app icons and window titles.
strings.多选，选 2 条及以上会自动聚合提速。可选策略组、节点，以及两个固定项「直连（不: Multi-select; choosing 2 or more aggregates them automatically for more speed. Options include policy groups, nodes and two fixed entries: "Direct (no proxy)" and "Reject (block connection)".
strings.仅选 2 条以上线路时出现：「轮询分散」（多连接自动分布到各线路）或「会话保持」: Appears only with 2+ lines: "round-robin" (connections spread across lines automatically) or "session-persistent".
strings.填「应用」时有三种办法：手输进程名、手输完整路径，或者点「选择程序文件」浏览到: There are three ways to fill in the app: type a process name, type a full path, or click "Choose program file" to browse for the exe. If unsure, pick straight from the running-process list (processes the core has seen currently or recently making connections) — icons and window titles make it easier to find the right one. Then the match method decides how the app is recognized: "By process name (recommended)" is shorter and more tolerant of moved or reinstalled programs; "By full path" is more precise.
strings.「目标线路」可以多选。可选的类型有策略组、节点，以及两个固定项：「直连（不走代理: Target lines is a multi-select. Choices include policy groups, nodes and two fixed entries: "Direct (no proxy)" and "Reject (block connection)". With 2+ lines the client creates an aggregation group so several lines serve the app at once; with one line, traffic takes just that line. Two or more lines also prompt for an aggregation policy: round-robin spreads connections across lines, while session-persistent keeps a session on one line.
strings.保存失败时，弹窗会给出下面这些提示，按提示补齐即可：: If saving fails, the dialog shows one of these messages — fix accordingly:
strings.请选择或输入应用进程: Select or enter an app process
strings.请至少选择一条目标线路: Select at least one target line
strings.该应用已在绑定列表中: This app is already in the binding list

strings.聚合里包含了「直连」或「拒绝」。: The aggregation included Direct or Reject.

strings.会给出提示，因为逗号要写入规则。: A warning is shown because commas are written into rules.
strings.浏览器走「自动选择」，游戏走「低延迟专线」，下载工具只选一条固定线路；也可以把某: Browser through "Auto Select", games through a "low-latency line", download tools pinned to a single fixed line; or set a chat app to "Reject" to block its connectivity. strings.当你不确定「谁在联网」「某个网站走了哪条线」时，就来这里。它把内核此刻正在处理的: When you're unsure who's online or which line a site took, come here. It lists every connection the core is handling right now, so you can verify routing results and fix them in place: right-click a connection to create a rule for its domain.

strings.<b>聚合视图</b>——按域名 / 目标合并同类连接，适合看清整体分布。列包括: Aggregated view — merges similar connections by domain / destination to reveal the overall picture. Columns: domain / destination, connections, process, rule, chain, up, down.
strings.在任意一条连接行上<b>右键</b>，会弹出菜单，包含以下几项：: Right-click any connection row to open a menu with:
strings.<b>此域名直连</b>——让该域名的流量直接出去，不走代理。: Direct for this domain — traffic to this domain goes out directly, bypassing the proxy.
strings.<b>此域名走指定线路</b>——子菜单列出可用代理组，选定后该域名走该组。若无: Route this domain through a chosen line — a submenu lists available proxy groups; pick one and the domain routes through it. With no groups available the submenu shows "No proxy groups available".
strings.<b>复制域名</b>——把该连接的域名复制到剪贴板。: Copy domain — copies the connection's domain to the clipboard.
strings.<b>复制目标地址</b>——复制连接的目标地址。: Copy destination — copies the connection's destination address.
strings.<b>复制进程路径</b>——复制发起连接的进程完整路径。: Copy process path — copies the full path of the process that opened the connection.
strings.选择「此域名直连」或「此域名走指定线路」，会创建一条<b>快捷规则</b>。它的: Choosing "Direct for this domain" or "Route this domain through a chosen line" creates a quick rule of type DOMAIN-SUFFIX. It's inserted at the very top of the rules when the runtime config is generated, so it outranks subscription rules and takes effect for that domain immediately — no core restart needed. To undo, right-click the domain again and pick a different line.
strings.连接的实时速率来自内核，连接关闭后不再显示。页面数据量大时，用上方的搜索 / 筛: Live speeds come from the core and disappear once a connection closes. With lots of data, use the search / filter above to narrow things down and find your target faster.
strings.无界互联（Unbound link）实时连接使用说明：查看正在联网的连接，并为域: Unbound link Connections guide: see what's online right now and create rules for domains on the fly.
strings.仪表盘是打开客户端后的第一屏，用来一眼看清整体状态，并直接切换代理组与节点。: The Dashboard is the first screen you see after opening the client — check the overall status at a glance and switch proxy groups and nodes right there.
strings.它的定位是「总览」：确认内核有没有在跑、当前流量是否正常、当前用的是哪个节点。日: Its role is the overview: is the core running, is traffic flowing normally, which node is active. The two most common everyday actions — check that you're connected and temporarily switch lines — both happen here, without visiting the Proxies page.
strings.页面顶部是内核状态卡片，显示内核是否运行，以及内核版本、内存占用、运行时长等信息: The core status card at the top shows whether the core is running, plus its version, memory usage and uptime — read by the client from the core so you can judge the background process's health. The sidebar footer also shows live "Core memory" and "App memory" usage, visible from anywhere.
strings.<b>运行中</b>：内核正在工作，代理能力可用。: Running: the core is working; proxying is available.
strings.<b>未运行</b>：内核没有跑起来，此时系统代理与节点都无法生效。: Not running: the core is down; the system proxy and nodes can't work.
strings.流量区给出三项概要数据，并配一条实时流量曲线：: The traffic section gives three summary figures and a live traffic chart:
strings.本次内核运行以来接收的总流量。: Total traffic received since the core started this time.
strings.本次内核运行以来发送的总流量。: Total traffic sent since the core started this time.
strings.当前正在进行的连接条数，可跳到「实时连接」查看明细。: The number of connections in progress; jump to Connections for details.
strings.上下行的即时速度走势，数据来自内核的 WebSocket 推送。: Instant up/down speed trends, pushed from the core over WebSocket.
strings.曲线动起来才算在传数据: Moving curves mean data is flowing
strings.打开一个网页或视频时，曲线应出现波动，累计下载数值随之增长。: Open a webpage or video and the curve should ripple while total download grows.
strings.仪表盘下部是代理组 / 节点切换行。每个代理组都有一行，可以直接在仪表盘为它选定: The lower part of the Dashboard holds the proxy group / node switch rows. Each proxy group gets a row where you can pick its current node right here:
strings.点开某个代理组的下拉框，选择要用的节点，改动立即生效。: Open a group's dropdown, pick a node, and the change takes effect immediately.
strings.需要测速、收藏或做更细的筛选时，再前往「代理节点」页。: For speed tests, favorites or finer filters, head to the Proxies page.
strings.一个订阅里通常有多个代理组，例如「选择节点」「自动选择」之类。你在仪表盘切换的是: A subscription usually has several proxy groups, like "Select" or "Auto Select". What you switch here is the group's current node; if the group uses an automatic policy it picks for itself, and a manual choice overrides the automatic result.
strings.在仪表盘怎么看 / 怎么做: How to read / do it here
strings.看累计下载 / 上传是否有数值并随上网增长，并确认当前节点延迟显示为数字。: See whether total download / upload has values that grow while you browse, and confirm the current node shows a latency number.
strings.在对应代理组的下拉框里选另一个节点即可，不需要离开本页。: Pick another node in the group's dropdown — no need to leave the page.
strings.看内核状态卡片是否为运行中，以及运行时长是否在正常累计。: Check the status card says Running and that uptime accumulates normally.
strings.内核显示未运行时: When the core shows as not running
strings.先到「设置」确认「自动启动内核」已开启；若开关正常但内核仍未运行，去「网络体检」: First check Settings to confirm "auto-start core" is on; if it is but the core still isn't running, head to Diagnostics to find the problem.
strings.无界互联（Unbound link）仪表盘使用说明：内核状态、实时流量与代理组节: Unbound link Dashboard guide: core status, live traffic and proxy group / node switching.
strings.网络体检会一次性检查内核、端口、系统代理、DNS、出口与泄漏等环节，逐项给出结论: Diagnostics checks the core, ports, system proxy, DNS, exits and leaks in one pass, with a conclusion and suggestion for each item, plus the network rescue kit.
strings.当「网页打不开」「代理没效果」时，不必靠猜。进入本页会<b>自动开始检查</b>: When pages won't load or the proxy seems ineffective, no need to guess. Entering the page starts the checks automatically; when done, the header summarizes results — e.g., "11 passed", "N notices", "N issues" — so you see the scale of the problem first. The "Re-run checks" button sits top-right and shows "Checking…" while running. Diagnostics only inspects; it never changes system settings — whether and what to repair is up to you.
strings.体检共 11 项，每项都会给出结论，异常项还会显示「建议：…」，直接告诉你下一步: There are 11 checks; each gives a conclusion, and abnormal ones show "Suggestion: …" telling you the next step.
strings.内核是否运行、版本，以及是否已提权。: Whether the core is running, its version, and whether it's elevated.
strings.混合端口 / 控制端口是否被其他程序占用。: Whether the mixed and control ports are taken by other programs.
strings.是否已开启系统代理，并指向本机混合端口。: Whether the system proxy is on and points at the local mixed port.
strings.解析耗时，以及使用的 DNS 地址。: Resolution time and the DNS addresses in use.
strings.TUN 模式下是否接管系统 DNS 解析。: Whether TUN mode takes over system DNS resolution.
strings.探测直连时的出口 IP。: The exit IP probed when connecting directly.
strings.探测走代理时的出口 IP；若与直连出口相同，会提示出口 IP 与直连相同。: The exit IP probed through the proxy; if it matches the direct exit, it warns that the exit IP equals the direct one.
strings.检查是否存在公网候选 IP，可能泄漏真实 IP 时给出告警。: Checks for public candidate IPs and warns when the real IP could leak.
strings.当前节点的延迟；不可达时建议「在代理节点页挑选一个可用节点」。: The current node's latency; when unreachable it suggests picking a working node on the Proxies page.
strings.直连可达性与耗时、HTTP 状态码。: Direct reachability, timing and HTTP status code.
strings.分组数与节点数。: The number of groups and nodes.
strings.页面下方是「断网急救箱」区域，说明文字为「代理异常退出、DNS 错误、网页打不开: The "Network rescue kit" section sits below, described as: "When the proxy exits unexpectedly, DNS breaks or pages won't load: detect first to locate the problem, then repair as prompted." It offers two buttons: "One-click rescue" and "Start check / Re-check".
strings.<b>一键急救</b>等于一次性完成两件事：重置系统代理，加上刷新 DNS 缓存: One-click rescue does two things at once: reset the system proxy and flush the DNS cache. Neither needs admin rights and both take effect immediately — good for the vast majority of temporary network failures. Start check / Re-check runs the dedicated outage checks on their own. Detect first to locate the problem, then decide whether to use one-click rescue.
strings.专项检测会检查 5 类问题，每类给出对应的修复按钮：: The dedicated checks cover five classes of problems, each with a matching repair button:
strings.代理仍指向 <code>127.0.0.1:7890</code>，但内核未运行: The proxy still points at 127.0.0.1:7890 while the core isn't running.
strings.刷新 DNS 缓存（<code>ipconfig /flushdns</code: Flush DNS cache (ipconfig /flushdns, no admin needed)
strings.网卡被设为 0.0.0.0 这类无效地址。: The adapter is set to invalid addresses like 0.0.0.0.
strings.重置 DNS 服务器 / 重置为自动获取（需管理员）: Reset DNS servers / set to automatic (admin required)
strings.存在自定义条目，或文件缺失。: Custom entries exist, or the file is missing.
strings.恢复 hosts 文件（先备份现有内容再重置为默认，需管理员）: Restore hosts file (backs up the current content first, then resets to default; admin required)
strings.不走代理也上不了网。: No internet even without the proxy.
strings.重置网络协议栈（重置 winsock 与 TCP/IP，需管理员，重启电脑后生效: Reset network stack (resets winsock and TCP/IP; admin required; takes effect after a reboot)
strings.需要管理员权限的修复会弹出 UAC 提权确认，同意后才会执行。执行危险操作前，界: Repairs needing admin rights trigger a UAC elevation prompt and only run once approved. Dangerous operations ask for confirmation first, with a red "Run" button — read the prompt before clicking. After a repair, the page re-runs the checks automatically to refresh the conclusions.
strings.先看体检的前 4 项——内核 / 端口 / 系统代理 / DNS 解析。这几项通: Start with the first four checks — core / ports / system proxy / DNS resolution. Once those pass, move on to the exit and leak checks — the scope narrows step by step.

strings.安装 → 导入订阅 → 打开订阅的启用开关 → 打开系统代理 → 在仪表盘确认节: Install → import a subscription → flip its enable switch → turn on the system proxy → confirm on the Dashboard that the node is connected. Just five steps.
strings.后面的章节会反复用到这几个词，先花一分钟建立印象：: Later chapters use these words constantly — take a minute to get familiar:
strings.真正干活的程序（mihomo）。它会随安装包一起装好，由客户端负责启动、守护和停: The program doing the real work (mihomo). It's installed with the app; the client starts, supervises and stops it — you never install or configure it separately.
strings.一条 http/https 链接，打开后是一份 YAML 配置，里面包含节点、策: An http/https link that opens to a YAML config containing nodes, policy groups and rules. The client downloads it as the raw material for generating the runtime config.
strings.节点是单条线路；代理组是一组节点的集合，可以按延迟自动选、手动切或做故障转移。: A node is a single line; a proxy group is a set of nodes that can auto-select by latency, switch manually or fail over.
strings.「什么流量走哪条线」的判断依据。命中最后一条都匹配不上时，走订阅里的兜底策略（通: The basis for deciding which line traffic takes. If nothing matches down to the last rule, the subscription's fallback policy applies (usually MATCH).
strings.修改 Windows 的 Internet 设置，让支持系统代理的程序（浏览器、: Modifies Windows Internet settings so programs that honor the system proxy (browsers, most desktop software) use it automatically. Requires the core to be running.
strings.创建虚拟网卡，把全部流量在网络层接管，能覆盖不认系统代理的程序（部分游戏、命令行: Creates a virtual adapter to take over all traffic at the network layer, covering apps that ignore the system proxy (some games, command-line tools). Requires admin rights.
strings.客户端把「订阅 + 你的覆写 + 应用级设置」合成的那份 <code>confi: The config.yaml the client assembles from "subscription + your overrides + app-level settings" — the file the core actually reads. You never edit it directly.

strings.主题、语言、失焦暂停渲染、代理页列数、隐藏超时节点、主题定制（颜色 / 字体 /: Theme, language, pause rendering when unfocused, Proxies page columns, hide timed-out nodes, theme customization (colors / fonts / custom CSS).
strings.系统代理（含绕过列表、终端代理命令）、开机自启、静默启动、启动页面、启动脚本、托: System proxy (with bypass list and terminal proxy commands), launch at startup, silent start, start page, startup script, tray click action, three-state tray icons, minimize to tray on close, traffic floating window, floating window mouse pass-through, system notifications, core watchdog, check for updates on launch, clear connections on node switch, system proxy guard, global shortcuts.
strings.端口与模式（混合代理端口、控制端口、运行模式、日志级别）、内核行为（自动启动内核: Ports and mode (mixed proxy port, control port, mode, log level), kernel behavior (auto-start core, allow LAN, IPv6, unified delay), web dashboard (with control secret), TUN mode, custom DNS (with fallback DNS and static Hosts), speed test and health (scheduled latency tests, node health monitoring, auto-switch on failure), network environment (automatic system-proxy and mode switching by Wi-Fi name).
