strings.订阅自动更新间隔、内核更新、节点测速地址与超时、应用日志、备份与恢复（含导出诊断: Subscription auto-update interval, core updates, node test URL and timeout, app logs, backup and restore (including export diagnostics).
strings.应用 logo 与应用名、应用版本、内核版本、数据目录（可一键打开）、帮助与支持: App logo and name, app version, core version, data directory (openable in one click), help and support (website and online user guide), developer tools, quit the app.
strings.所有设置项修改后立刻保存，没有「确定 / 应用」按钮。涉及内核的改动（如端口、T: Every setting saves immediately — no "OK / Apply" buttons. Core-related changes (ports, TUN, DNS) hot-reload or restart the core automatically, and switches in the UI reflect the actual state.
strings.无界互联（Unbound link）使用手册总览：五分钟上手路径、界面导览与常见: Unbound link User Guide overview: a five-minute getting-started path, interface tour and key terms.
strings.安装与首次运行 — 无界互联 使用手册: Install and First Run — Unbound link User Guide
strings.从下载安装包到确认节点连通，这一页给出完整顺序。按下面的「首次运行的五步」做完，: From downloading the installer to confirming nodes are connected, this page lays out the complete order. Complete the "five steps of first run" below and the client is ready to use.
strings.使用 TUN 模式需要管理员权限；开启系统代理同样需要管理员权限。日常只使用系统: TUN mode requires admin rights; enabling the system proxy likewise requires admin rights. If you only use the system proxy day to day, you can start with normal privileges and relaunch as administrator when you run into permission issues.
strings.无需自行安装 mihomo 内核。安装包已内含 mihomo 内核与 wintu: No need to install the mihomo core yourself. The installer already bundles the mihomo core and the wintun TUN driver; the client starts and supervises them.
strings.打开<a href=\"https://github.com/18gemail-: Open the download page, get the Windows installer (NSIS format) from Releases, double-click it and follow the prompts. The current version is 0.1.1.
strings.首次运行时，如果数据目录不存在，客户端会依次尝试从历史目录名迁移旧配置，让从老版: On first run, if the data directory doesn't exist, the client tries migrating old configs from historical directory names so users upgrading from older versions keep their subscriptions and settings.
strings.保持安装程序给出的默认目录，不要修改到其它位置。: Keep the default directory the installer suggests; don't change it to another location.
strings.全新安装首次打开客户端时，会自动弹出一个四步引导，陪你完成最初的设置：: On a fresh install, the first launch opens a four-step guide that walks you through the initial setup:
strings.<b>欢迎</b>——一句话了解客户端：订阅管理、规则分流、流量观测全部在本地完: Welcome — a one-line intro to the app: subscription management, rule-based routing and traffic insights all happen locally, with no account needed.
strings.<b>导入订阅</b>——直接在引导里粘贴订阅链接完成导入；也可以跳过，稍后在「: Import a subscription — paste your subscription link right in the guide to import it, or skip and add one later under Profiles.
strings.<b>快速设置</b>——三个推荐开关：开机自动启动、系统通知、内核看门狗，可随: Quick setup — three recommended toggles: launch at login, system notifications and the core watchdog; change them anytime in Settings.
strings.<b>开始使用</b>——列出几个小技巧：Ctrl+K 打开命令面板、关闭窗口自: Get started — a few handy tips: Ctrl+K opens the command palette, closing the window minimizes to the tray, and Diagnostics checks your network in one click.
strings.每一步都可以点「上一步」回看；点「跳过」或走到最后完成引导后，它不会再自动弹出。: Every step has a Back button; after you click Skip or finish the guide it won't pop up again. Users upgrading from older versions are unaffected and won't see it.
strings.首次运行的五步: The five steps of first run
strings.进入「订阅管理」，点右上角「添加订阅」，粘贴 http/https 订阅链接（名: Go to Profiles, click "Add subscription" top-right, paste your http/https link (name can be left blank — the client detects it), and click OK.
strings.打开新增订阅卡片上的启用开关（首个订阅会自动启用）。卡片上出现蓝色「使用中」标签: Flip the enable switch on the new subscription card (the first subscription is enabled automatically). A blue "In use" badge appears once it's on — multiple subscriptions can be enabled at the same time.
strings.打开「设置 → 网络」，确认「自动启动内核」已开启（默认开启）。开启后内核会在需: Open Settings → Network and confirm "auto-start core" is on (on by default). The core then starts by itself whenever needed — no manual action required.
strings.打开「设置 → 常规 → 系统集成」，打开「系统代理」。: Open Settings → General → System integration and turn on the "system proxy".
strings.回到「仪表盘」，确认内核状态为运行中，并且当前节点显示延迟数值。: Return to the Dashboard, confirm the core status is Running and the current node shows a latency number.
strings.让流量走代理的三种方式: Three ways to route traffic through the proxy
strings.客户端不强制接管所有流量，你可以按需要选择覆盖范围：: The client never forces a full takeover — choose the scope you need:
strings.最省事，覆盖浏览器等大多数桌面程序。: The least hassle; covers browsers and most desktop programs.
strings.修改 Windows 的 Internet 设置，需要内核正在运行。: Modifies Windows Internet settings; requires the core to be running.
strings.全流量接管，覆盖不认系统代理的程序（部分游戏、命令行工具）。: Full traffic takeover, covering apps that ignore the system proxy (some games, command-line tools).
strings.只让指定应用走代理，其余应用保持直连。: Only chosen apps use the proxy; everything else stays direct.
strings.在「应用分流」页按应用添加规则即可。: Add per-app rules on the App Routing page.
strings.全部运行期数据都存放在 <code>%APPDATA%\\com.unbound: All runtime data lives in %APPDATA%\com.unboundlink.desktop, mainly:
strings.各订阅的原文。: The original YAML of each subscription.
strings.生成的运行时配置，即内核真正读取的文件。: The generated runtime config — the file the core actually reads.
strings.内置 Web 面板静态文件。: Static files for the built-in web dashboard.
strings.规则命中统计与流量历史。: Rule hit statistics and traffic history.
strings.需要整机迁移或重装前，打开「设置 → 维护 → 备份与恢复」，可以导出和导入 J: Before migrating machines or reinstalling, open Settings → Maintenance → Backup and restore to export and import a JSON backup. It contains settings, subscriptions, Merge config and the core version.
strings.程序支持单实例，重复启动会回到已有窗口。主窗口、悬浮窗、托盘面板在关闭时都是隐藏: The app is single-instance — launching it again returns to the existing window. The main window, floating window and tray panel all hide rather than exit when closed; to really quit, use Settings → About → Quit.
strings.无界互联（Unbound link）安装与首次运行：系统要求、安装步骤、首次运行: Unbound link install and first run: system requirements, installation steps, the five-step first-run setup, three ways to route traffic and data directory backup.
strings.运行日志记录客户端与内核在运行过程中的全部输出，是排查异常时最直接的依据。: Logs record all output from the client and the core — the most direct evidence when troubleshooting.
strings.无论是订阅更新失败、配置重载报错，还是内核启动不成功，最终都会在这里留下记录。遇: Failed subscription updates, config reload errors, a core that won't start — they all leave records here. When trouble hits, don't rush to change settings; come here first to see who reported the error and at which step.
strings.同一个视图里其实混着两类日志，它们都由内核与客户端实时推送，按时间先后排列：: The view mixes two kinds of logs, both pushed in real time by the core and the client, arranged in time order:
strings.mihomo 内核自身的输出，例如连接、DNS、规则匹配等信息。: Output from the mihomo core itself — connections, DNS, rule matching and so on.
strings.来自内核的 WebSocket 推送。: Pushed from the core over WebSocket.
strings.客户端自身的动作，例如订阅更新、配置重载、内核启停。: The client's own actions — subscription updates, config reloads, core start/stop.
strings.行首带 <code>[无界互联]</code> 前缀。: Lines start with a [Unbound link] prefix.
strings.看前缀就能分辨是谁说的话: The prefix tells you who's speaking
strings.带 <code>[无界互联]</code> 前缀的是客户端自己打印的；不带前缀的: Lines with a [Unbound link] prefix are printed by the client; those without come from the core.
strings.视图顶部提供级别筛选：调试 / 信息 / 警告 / 错误，分别对应内核日志级别: Level filters sit at the top: Debug / Info / Warning / Error, matching the core log levels debug / info / warning / error. To focus, tick only the levels you care about — everything else is filtered out.
strings.最详细的输出，排查问题时用。: The most detailed output; use it when troubleshooting.
strings.不影响运行但值得留意的提示。: Notices that don't break anything but deserve attention.
strings.真正出错的行，优先处理。: Lines that truly failed — handle these first.
strings.筛选只改变「显示哪些」，并不会改变「记录哪些」。要拿到更详细的日志，需要到「设置: Filtering only changes what's shown, not what's recorded. For more detailed logs, adjust Settings → Network → Log level; options are Debug / Info / Warning / Error / Silent.
strings.先把日志级别调到「调试」，再复现问题，这样能把出错前后的完整过程都记录下来；问题: Switch the level to Debug first, then reproduce the problem, so the full sequence around the failure gets recorded; once found, set it back to Info to keep logs from bloating.
strings.日志量大时，按下面的顺序看效率最高：: With lots of logs, reading in this order is most efficient:
strings.先找带 <code>[无界互联]</code> 前缀的错误行——它直接指出客户端: First find error lines with the [Unbound link] prefix — they point straight at the client step that failed.
strings.再看内核的 error 行——了解地址、规则或连接层面的具体报错。: Then the core's error lines — the concrete failures at the address, rule or connection level.
strings.最后看 warning 行——确认是否存在被忽略的隐患。: Finally warning lines — to check for overlooked risks.
strings.需要针对具体故障现象对照处理时，可参考<a href=\"./troublesh: For symptom-by-symptom fixes see Troubleshooting; if you suspect a network-layer problem, use Diagnostics alongside it.
Besides the on-screen view, logs are written in real time to logs\app.log in the data directory for complete records. Files rotate by size: when full, they're archived as app.1.log, app.2.log and so on; archives older than the retention window are cleaned up automatically.
strings.记录哪些等级、单个文件多大、保留多少份、保留多少天，都在「设置 → 维护 → 应: Which levels are recorded, file size, file count and retention days are all set under Settings → Maintenance → App logs; "Open log folder" takes you straight there. Note this is separate from Settings → Network → Log level (which controls core logs).
strings.无界互联（Unbound link）运行日志使用说明：两类日志来源、按级别筛选、: Unbound link Logs guide: the two log sources, level filtering, log level settings and troubleshooting order.
strings.这里管理你的订阅来源：添加订阅链接、导入本地配置、启用一个或多个订阅、导入单个节: Manage your subscription sources here: add links, import local configs, enable one or more subscriptions, import single node links, update node lists, and fine-tune what you get from subscriptions with Merge and Script.
strings.标题下方显示「N 个订阅 · 已启用 M 个订阅」，并提示当前自动更新状态，例如: Below the title it shows "N subscriptions · M enabled" plus the auto-update status, e.g. "Auto-update every 12 hours" or "Auto-update off". Four buttons sit top-right: "Update all", "Refresh", "Import local config" and "Add subscription". Update all refreshes every subscription in turn; Refresh just re-reads local state; Import local config adds a local YAML file to the list as a subscription.
strings.点「添加订阅」打开弹窗，里面只有两个输入项：: Click "Add subscription" to open the dialog — just two fields:
strings.必填，必须是 http/https 链接。留空提交会提示「请输入订阅链接」。: Required; must be an http/https link. Submitting empty shows "Please enter a subscription URL".
strings.可选。留空时客户端会自动识别。: Optional; the client detects it automatically when left blank.
strings.每个订阅是一张卡片，按住卡片即可拖动排序。卡片上显示名称、已启用订阅的蓝色「使用: Each subscription is a card; press and hold to drag-reorder. Cards show the name, a blue "In use" badge on every enabled subscription (several can appear at once), the URL (truncated when long), a relative "Updated …" time, and subscription info (traffic usage, expiry, etc., when the provider supplies it). The right side holds the enable switch followed by the action buttons:
strings.打开即启用该订阅，可同时启用多个；所有已启用的订阅都带蓝色「使用中」标签。: Flip it on to enable this subscription; several can be enabled at once — every enabled subscription carries the blue "In use" badge.
strings.刷新订阅信息，核对流量用量与到期时间。: Refreshes subscription info to check usage and expiry.
strings.生成二维码，用手机扫码导入。: Generates a QR code to import on your phone.
strings.列出该订阅的历史留档，可回退到任意旧版本（本地订阅没有此项）。: Lists the archived versions of this subscription so you can roll back to any of them (not available for local configs).
strings.识别到机场官网地址时出现，点击用默认浏览器打开；图标旁的圆点显示连通性（绿=可达: Appears when the provider's website is detected; click to open it in your default browser. The dot beside the icon shows reachability (green = reachable, red = unreachable) — hover to see check details.
strings.修改订阅名称与机场官网地址（识别不到官网时可在这里手动填写，留空则恢复自动识别）: Edits the subscription name and the provider's website (if none was detected, fill it in here; leave empty to restore auto-detection).
strings.调整订阅在列表中的顺序。: Reorders the subscription in the list.
strings.红色按钮，会二次确认「删除该订阅？删除后不可恢复」。: Red button; asks "Delete this subscription? This cannot be undone."
strings.订阅可以同时启用多个：打开卡片右上角的启用开关即可，所有已启用的订阅都带蓝色「使: Several subscriptions can be enabled at once: just flip the enable switch at the top-right of a card, and every enabled subscription carries the blue "In use" badge. The first enabled subscription supplies the base config — port, DNS, run mode — while the others merge their nodes, proxy groups and rules into the same runtime config; the effective order follows the list from top to bottom, so drag cards to reorder.
strings.每次远程更新订阅前，旧内容会自动留档，最多保留 5 份。点订阅卡片上的时钟图标打: Before every remote update, the old content is archived automatically, keeping up to 5 versions. Click the clock icon on a subscription card to open the version history dialog, which shows each snapshot's time and node count; click Restore to roll back to that version.
strings.恢复时如果订阅正在启用，运行配置会立即热重载；覆盖当前内容前也会先自动留档，所以: If the subscription is enabled, rolling back hot-reloads the running config immediately; the current content is archived first, so you can always undo the rollback. Local configs don't take part in remote updates, so they have no version history. After an update the card shows change badges for node and rule counts (green for growth, red for shrink), and a warning pops up if the node count drops by more than half.
strings.点「导入本地配置」，选择一个本地 YAML 配置文件，客户端会把它复制进数据目录: Click "Import local config" and pick a local YAML file; the client copies it into the data directory and adds it to the list as a subscription, tagged "Local" and labeled "local config file (excluded from remote updates)". Handy for configs you maintain yourself or got from elsewhere — no need to upload to a server first.
strings.本地订阅不参与远程更新与自动更新，「全部更新」会跳过它；配置文件保存在数据目录里: Local subscriptions take part in neither remote updates nor auto-update; "Update all" skips them. The file lives in the data directory — re-import it when moving to a new version. Success shows "Local config imported".
strings.页面底部的「手动节点」卡片用来收纳订阅之外的单个节点：点右上角「导入节点链接」，: The "Manual Nodes" card at the bottom of the page holds single nodes outside any subscription: click "Import links", paste the node links into the dialog (one per line), click "Parse" to preview, then "Import N" to finish. Common protocols are supported — ss / vmess / vless / trojan / hysteria2 / tuic / socks5 / http; failed lines are reported individually and duplicate names are skipped automatically.
strings.手动节点保存在数据目录里，生成运行时配置时并入同名代理组（默认组名「手动节点」）: Manual nodes live in the data directory and merge into a proxy group of the same name when the runtime config is generated (default group name: "Manual Nodes"). Remove imported nodes one by one on the card; changes save immediately and hot-reload the config.
strings.页面底部有「全局扩展覆写配置」扩展卡片，带 <b>Merge</b> 标签。点开: At the bottom sits the "Global override config" card with a Merge tag. Open it and write a YAML snippet — when the runtime config is generated it's deeply merged recursively with the subscription to override its fields (app-level settings such as port, control secret and mode are written by the client — writing them here has no effect; change them under Settings → Network). Saving shows "Merge config saved and applied".
strings.相邻的「全局扩展脚本」扩展卡片带 <b>Script</b> 标签。点开后在弹窗: Next to it, the "Global extension script" card with a Script tag. Open it and write JavaScript implementing function main(config){ … return config }. The client runs it on the built-in QuickJS engine to batch-rename nodes, add or remove rules and more. Saving shows "Extension script saved and applied". A sample script using regex to strip ads from node names comes built in.
strings.自动更新的间隔在「设置 → 维护 → 订阅」里设置，单位小时，<b>0 表示关闭: The auto-update interval is set under Settings → Maintenance → Subscription, in hours, 0 means off (off by default). Once enabled, every subscription in the list updates on schedule in the background; when done, the config reloads automatically and a system notification is sent.
strings.同处还有两个与订阅联动的开关：「更新后自动选优」默认关闭，开启后每次订阅更新并重: Two subscription-linked switches live in the same place: "Auto-optimize after update" is off by default — once enabled, every time a subscription update finishes and the config reloads, it tests the main proxy group and switches the current node to the lowest-latency one; "Profile usage alerts" is on by default and sends a system notification when used traffic reaches the threshold, remaining days run low or the subscription has expired, each tier firing only once. Both rely on the traffic and expiry info provided by the subscription source.
strings.更新失败先查网络: If updates fail, check the network first
strings.更新失败通常是订阅链接失效或网络不通。可以先在「网络体检」确认网络状态，再回到本: Failed updates usually mean a dead URL or a broken connection. Check the network in Diagnostics, then come back and retry "Update".
strings.无界互联（Unbound link）订阅管理：添加与更新订阅、多订阅同时启用、拖: Unbound link Profiles: add and update subscriptions, enable several at once, drag to reorder, roll back with version history, import node links, Merge overrides and extension scripts, auto-update and troubleshooting.
strings.本页浏览订阅带来的节点与分组，切换线路、测速、收藏，并为受限节点配置链式代理。: This page browses the nodes and groups your subscriptions bring, switches lines, tests latency, favorites nodes and configures chained proxies for restricted nodes.
strings.页面左侧是一列条目，包含分组、节点来源（供应商 / 订阅）以及其他分组。点击某个: A column on the left lists entries: groups, node sources (providers / subscriptions) and other groups. Click an entry to show its nodes on the right. Each entry has a ⟳ icon that "updates the node list from the source right now", re-fetching the nodes under that entry. Group entries carry notes like: other groups pick routes by their own policy, e.g. auto-selecting the lowest-latency node. Their routes come from the subscription — no need to specify them one by one.
strings.右侧顶部的工具区用来缩小范围、改变显示顺序。搜索框可搜分组、节点、供应商，并支持: The toolbar at the top-right narrows the range and changes display order. The search box covers groups, nodes and providers, and accepts region abbreviations like hk. The sort dropdown offers default order, sort by latency and sort by name. The difference: search filters — only matches remain; sorting just reorders without removing anything.
strings.可搜分组、节点、供应商；支持地区缩写，如输入 <code>hk</code>。: Searches groups, nodes and providers; accepts region abbreviations like hk.
strings.默认顺序 / 按延迟排序 / 按名称排序。: Default order / by latency / by name.
strings.开启后测速超时的节点不显示，让列表更清爽；开关会记住状态，与设置页「隐藏测速超时: Nodes that timed out in tests are hidden for a cleaner list; the switch remembers its state and is the same setting as "hide timed-out nodes" in Settings.
strings.重新读取当前条目下的节点。: Re-reads the nodes under the current entry.
strings.对当前条目下所有节点批量测延迟。: Tests latency for every node under the current entry.
strings.工具区下方是筛选栏，包含地区筛选胶囊（含「全部」）与「只看收藏」。地区胶囊用来只: Below the toolbar sits the filter bar with region pills (including "All") and "Favorites only". Region pills show nodes from one region; Favorites only shows starred nodes. Drag the bar sideways to pan through it — no need to squeeze many regions onto one screen.
strings.节点列表右上角有一个「列表 / 地图」切换按钮。切到地图视图后，右侧会显示一幅世: A "List / Map" toggle sits at the top-right of the node list. Switch to map view and a world map appears on the right, with nodes aggregated into dots by country and region: the region a dot lands in is where your nodes are, so the global spread reads at a glance.
strings.光点的大小代表该地区的节点数量，越大节点越多；颜色代表该地区内最优节点的延迟——: Dot size reflects how many nodes a region has — bigger means more. Color reflects the best latency within the region: green is fast, orange is moderate, red is slow, and grey means no node there has been latency-tested yet. The region of the node currently in use is ringed with a highlight to locate the active line at a glance. Hover a dot to see the region name, node count and best latency.
strings.点击任意光点即可按该地区筛选节点：视图自动切回列表，筛选栏中对应地区的胶囊被选中: Click any dot to filter nodes by that region: the view switches back to the list, the matching region pill in the filter bar becomes selected, and only that region's nodes remain on the right — "see the map, drill into the list" in one step. Click "All" in the filter bar to restore everything. The list and the map share the same nodes and filters, so switching back and forth loses nothing.
strings.地图数据内置在客户端里，渲染无需联网，不依赖任何在线地图服务。: Map data is built into the app; rendering needs no network and no online map service.
strings.每张节点卡片显示节点名与延迟（延迟带配色，方便一眼看出快慢）。卡片上还有几个可点: Each node card shows the node name and latency (color-coded so speed reads at a glance). Clickable elements on the card:
strings.收藏该节点，收藏节点始终置顶。: Favorites the node; favorites always float to the top.
strings.参与链式代理的节点名后显示角色标签：<b>入口</b>（第一跳）/ <b>中转<: Nodes in a chain show role tags after their names: Entry (first hop) / Relay / Exit (final landing); hover to see the order.
strings.开启「节点健康监控」后，卡片会附带一条近期延迟折线（红点表示该次测速失败），一眼: With Node health monitoring on, each card carries a recent latency line (red dots mark failed tests), so you can tell at a glance whether a node is stable.
strings.两种测速有什么不同: The two kinds of speed tests
strings.闪电按钮做的是延迟测试，结果与卡片上的延迟数值一致，适合快速比一比谁更近。仪表按: The lightning button runs a latency test — the same figure shown on the card, good for quickly comparing who's closer. The gauge button runs a download speed test, taking about 10 seconds; during the test the exit switches to that node temporarily and restores the previous node afterwards, so there's nothing to switch back manually. To triage a large batch of nodes, "Test all" in the toolbar is easier.
strings.测速结果的有效期约为 10 分钟，过期会自动清除，避免用旧数据误导判断。看到某个: Test results stay valid for about 10 minutes, then clear automatically so stale data doesn't mislead. A node with no latency number usually just has expired results — test again. To keep timed-out nodes out of the list, turn on "Hide timed-out" at the top of the page.
strings.如果开启了「节点健康监控」（设置 → 网络），每次测速的结果还会被滚动记录下来，: With Node health monitoring enabled (Settings → Network), every test result is recorded on a rolling basis and drawn as a latency trend line on the node card: the line reflects recent latency levels and red dots mark failed tests; if the node in use keeps failing tests, the app sends a system notification and, with Automatic failover on, also switches the line to the fallback node (or the lowest-latency available node in the group) and reports the result. Right after you enable monitoring there's little data, so the line fills in as you test more or as scheduled tests run.
strings.有些节点本身受限、直连不稳，可以给它加一段前置中转，让流量先经中转再从这里出去—: Some nodes are restricted or unstable when reached directly; give them a front relay so traffic goes through the relay first and exits here — one such relationship is a "chain". Click "Chained proxy rules" in the toolbar to open the chain editor (a drawer on the right): saved chains on the left, a visual builder on the right, with a complete chain shown as "This device → Hop 1 → Hop 2 → Internet".
strings.搭建一条链路：点「新建链路」，在下方候选列表里点选环节依次加入。候选列表支持搜索: To build a chain: click "New chain" and click hops in the candidate list below to add them in order. The list supports search and region filters, pins favorites on top, shows each node's latest latency on the right (from the core's test records; untested nodes show none), and pools all direct nodes — no need to switch left-side groups when picking across them. Click a hop again to remove it; drag hop blocks to reorder; click the + between hops to set the insertion point, and the next hop you click goes there.
strings.只能作为链路第一环（入口），例如「香港自动组 → 落地节点」；普通节点可放在任意: Can only be the chain's first hop (entry), e.g. "HK Auto → landing node"; regular nodes can go anywhere.
strings.按住环节块拖动即可调整它在链路中的位置。: Press and drag a hop block to reposition it in the chain.
strings.移出该环节；环节之间的 <b>+</b> 用于设定下一个环节的插入位置。: Removes the hop; the + between hops sets where the next hop is inserted.
strings.环节已不在已启用的订阅中会标红提示；「移除失效链路」可一键清理，保存后生效。: Hops no longer present in the enabled subscriptions are flagged in red; "Remove invalid chains" cleans them up in one click, applied on save.
strings.点「保存并应用」后，整条链路会一次性写入并热重载运行配置，立即生效。使用时选中链: Clicking "Save and apply" writes the whole chain and hot-reloads the runtime config at once — effective immediately. To use it, select the chain's last node and the full path is used; selecting a middle hop passes only through the hops before it. The first hop alone isn't a chain (it's a relay referenced by later hops). Chained latency is roughly the sum of all hops — usually slower, but potentially more stable.
strings.如果只是想给某一个节点快速指定前置，仍可以在节点卡片上点链式按钮，在弹窗里选择前: To quickly give one node a front proxy, still click the chain button on its card and pick a front node or group in the dialog; such quick rules also appear in the chain editor as chains and remain editable.
strings.在仪表盘或本页切换节点后，内核会热重载配置，不需要重启内核，也不必停止后再启动。: Switching nodes on the Dashboard or this page hot-reloads the config — no core restart, no stop-and-start needed.
strings.无界互联（Unbound link）代理节点：分组浏览、搜索与地区筛选、地图视图: Unbound link Proxies: group browsing, search and region filters, map view, latency tests, favorites, latency trends, download speed tests and chained proxy configuration.
strings.「规则列表」页回答「什么流量走哪条线」：它列出当前正在生效的规则、订阅里引用的规: The Rules page answers "which line does which traffic take": it lists the rules in effect, the rule sets your subscription references, and how often each rule is actually hit.
strings.页面顶部有四个页签：<b>规则列表</b>、<b>自定义规则</b>、<b>规则: Four tabs at the top: Rules, Custom rules, Rule sets and Hit statistics — different facets of the same rule set: "what rules exist", "which extra rules I want", "where they come from" and "how well they're used". Switch tabs to view each without leaving the page.
strings.默认展示的第一个页签，列出当前运行时配置里的全部规则。数据来自内核真正读取的那份: The default first tab lists every rule in the current runtime config. Data comes from the exact config the core reads — your subscription and overrides combined. Four columns:
strings.规则的匹配类型，例如 DOMAIN-SUFFIX、GEOIP 等。: The match type, e.g. DOMAIN-SUFFIX, GEOIP and so on.
strings.这条规则要匹配的域名、IP 段或地区。: The domain, IP range or region this rule matches.
strings.命中这条规则后，流量从哪个出口出去，通常是一个代理组、一个节点名，或 DIREC: Where matched traffic exits — usually a proxy group, a node name, or a built-in policy like DIRECT or REJECT.
strings.这条规则累计被命中多少次。: How many times this rule has been hit in total.
strings.规则数量往往很多，上方提供了筛选与搜索：可按类型筛选，也可按关键词搜索匹配内容。: Rule counts are often large, so filtering and search sit above: filter by type or search the match content by keyword. Long results paginate automatically to help you find a specific rule.
strings.「自定义规则」页签是一个可视化编辑器：不用手写配置文件，在这里增删改自己的分流规: The Custom rules tab is a visual editor: add, edit and reorder your own routing rules without hand-writing config files. On Save & apply they are injected at the very top of the runtime rules in list order, outranking quick rules and subscription rules.
strings.编辑是草稿式的：所有改动先停留在页面上，出现「放弃修改」按钮与「有未保存的修改」: Editing is draft-style: changes stay on the page, a Discard changes button and an unsaved-changes note appear, and nothing is written until you click Save & apply, which hot-reloads the core; Discard changes restores the saved state. The table shows all rules in the draft with six columns: #, Type, Match, Policy, Extra and Actions. Each row has four buttons: Move up, Move down, Edit and Delete; higher rows have higher priority, and Move up on the first row and Move down on the last are disabled.
strings.点「新增规则」或行内的编辑按钮弹出表单，共四项：: Click Add rule or a row's Edit button to open a form with four fields:
strings.如 DOMAIN-SUFFIX、GEOSITE、IP-CIDR 等；可直接输入，: e.g. DOMAIN-SUFFIX, GEOSITE, IP-CIDR; type freely or pick from the common suggestions — values are upper-cased automatically.
strings.规则要匹配的域名、IP 段或地区。选择 MATCH 类型时不需要填写。: The domain, IP range or region to match. Not needed for the MATCH type.
strings.命中后的出口：DIRECT、REJECT，或内核当前的策略组与节点名（可从建议列: The exit on a hit: DIRECT, REJECT, or a proxy group / node name from the running core (pick from the suggestions).
strings.仅对 IP 类规则（IP-CIDR、GEOIP 等）显示；开启后这类规则跳过域名: Shown only for IP-type rules (IP-CIDR, GEOIP and the like); when on, these rules skip DNS resolution to avoid needless lookups.
strings.规则类型限定为大写字母、数字与连字符，匹配内容与目标策略里不能包含逗号或换行；保: Rule types are limited to upper-case letters, digits and hyphens, and Match / Target must not contain commas or line breaks; if any rule fails validation the whole save is rejected with the offending row number. Up to 200 custom rules.
strings.MATCH 规则会「截断」后面的规则: A MATCH rule truncates everything after it
strings.自定义规则插入的是规则列表最前，而匹配顺序是从前往后、一旦命中就不再往下走。如果: Custom rules go to the very top of the rule list, and matching runs top to bottom — the first hit wins. Put a MATCH rule first and nothing below it will ever match.
strings.规则集页签列出订阅里引用的规则集，也就是 <code>rule-provider: The Rule sets tab lists the rule sets your subscription references — rule-provider entries. Rule sets bundle large batches of rules into external files to keep the main config lean; once referenced, their rules match alongside the rest. Five columns:
strings.该规则集包含多少条规则。: How many rules the set contains.
strings.该规则集最近一次更新的时间。: When the rule set was last updated.
strings.命中统计页签把规则按实际使用情况呈现出来，表格共四列：<b>类型</b>、<b>: The Hit statistics tab presents rules by actual usage in four columns: Type, Match, Exit and Hits, so you can see which rules really pull their weight.
strings.这些数据由客户端在内核运行后<b>每 15 秒采样一次</b>连接记录并累计落盘: The client samples connection records every 15 seconds while the core runs and accumulates them to disk, so right after launch it may show "No statistics yet (sampled every 15 seconds while the core runs)" — data trickles in shortly after. Statistics are persisted and survive restarts.
strings.规则列表页的工具区有一个「分流模拟」按钮：输入一个域名、IP 或进程名，就能在本: The toolbar on the Rules page has a Route simulator button: type a domain, IP or process name and it replays locally which rule would match and what its policy is. No running core is required — very handy for working out why a site went the way it did.
strings.模拟器支持两种输入：<b>域名 / IP</b> 按域名类与 IP 类规则匹配；: Two input modes are supported: Domain / IP matches domain- and IP-based rules; App process matches process rules (e.g. chrome.exe). Results show the matched rule number, its text and policy; if the policy is a proxy group, the group's current exit node is resolved too.
strings.少数规则无法在本地精确判断（如依赖 GeoSite / GeoIP 数据、正则或: A few rules cannot be decided locally (those relying on GeoSite / GeoIP data, regex, or pending domain resolution); the simulator lists them as skipped instead of giving a wrong answer, and malformed input gets its own hint. Every decision is based on the current runtime config — the same rules the core actually uses.
strings.规则的生效顺序是从上到下匹配，先命中先用。运行时配置里规则的排布顺序为：<b>自: Rules match top to bottom; the first hit wins. In the runtime config the order is: custom rules (arranged in the Rules page editor) → quick rules (right-click on the Connections page) → subscription rules. Both in-app sources sit above subscription rules, with custom rules highest. App routing bindings match by process and also apply at config generation time.
strings.先检查当前运行模式是否为「规则」：设置 → 网络 → 运行模式。「全局」模式下所: First check the mode is "Rule": Settings → Network → Mode. In Global mode all traffic takes one exit and rules have no effect.
strings.无界互联（Unbound link）规则列表使用说明：查看生效规则、自定义规则编: Unbound link Rules guide: view active rules, the custom rule editor, subscription rule sets and hit statistics.
strings.端口、运行模式、TUN、DNS、快捷键、应用日志与备份都集中在这里，分为「外观: Ports, mode, TUN, DNS, shortcuts, app logs and backups all live here, split into six tabs: Appearance / System / Network / Tools / Maintenance / About. Each tab is grouped by function, with setting cards under each group title. This page explains every switch's effect and default value.
strings.每个开关和输入框改动后立刻保存，界面底部同样显示「所有设置修改即时保存」，没有确: Every switch and input saves immediately; the footer also reads "All settings save instantly" — no OK / Apply buttons. Core-related changes (ports, TUN, DNS) hot-reload or restart the core automatically.
strings.外观页只有「外观与主题」一个分组：外观卡片管理主题、语言与界面行为，主题定制卡片: The Appearance tab has one group, "Appearance and theme": the appearance card manages theme, language and UI behavior; the theme customization card manages colors, fonts and custom CSS.
strings.切换后界面实时变化，无需重启。: The UI updates instantly on switching; no restart.
strings.界面语言，内置 13 种语言并支持跟随系统，切换后即时生效。: The UI language — 13 built in, plus follow-system; applies immediately.
strings.窗口失去焦点时暂停流量图表刷新，降低 CPU 与内存占用；流量记录不受影响，回到: Pauses traffic chart refresh when the window loses focus to cut CPU and memory use; recording continues and refresh resumes on focus.
strings.代理页节点卡片的每行列数，可选 1 - 4 列；「自动」按窗口宽度自适应。: Cards per row on the Proxies page, 1–4; "Auto" fits the window width.
strings.开启后测速超时的节点不在代理页显示，与代理页顶部的「隐藏超时」开关为同一设置。: When on, timed-out nodes are hidden on the Proxies page; the same setting as "Hide timed-out" at the top of that page.
strings.除三档主题外，还可以打开「主题定制」微调界面：支持调整八类颜色、自定义界面字体并: Beyond the three themes, open "Theme customization" to fine-tune the UI: eight color categories, a custom UI font and custom CSS, all applied instantly. "Restore defaults" clears every customization (with confirmation).
strings.按钮、选中态、提示与延迟颜色使用的主色，留空即用默认值。: The main colors for buttons, selected states, notices and latency; leave blank for defaults.
strings.次级强调与悬停底色使用的颜色，留空即用默认值。: Color for secondary emphasis and hover backgrounds; leave blank for the default.
strings.正文与标题、说明文字与弱化信息分别使用的文字颜色，留空即用默认值。: Text colors for body and headings, and for captions and de-emphasized info; leave blank for defaults.
strings.自定义界面字体族，按 CSS font-family 语法填写；留空使用默认字体: Custom UI font family in CSS font-family syntax; blank uses the default stack.
strings.附加的全局样式表，可微调界面细节；出错时清空即可恢复。: An extra global stylesheet for fine-tuning details; clear it to recover from mistakes.
strings.分为「代理与启动」（系统代理、启动）和「托盘与守护」（托盘与悬浮窗、后台守护）两: Two groups, "Proxy and startup" (system proxy, startup) and "Tray and watchdog" (tray and floating window, background watchdog), with global shortcuts at the end.
strings.写入 Windows 的 Internet 设置，让支持系统代理的程序自动走代理: Writes Windows Internet settings so programs that honor the system proxy use it automatically. Requires the core to be running.
strings.分号 / 逗号分隔的通配条目（如 <code>*.local;192.168.*: Semicolon / comma-separated wildcard entries (e.g. *.local;192.168.*) whose addresses bypass the proxy; blank keeps the system's existing config. Shown only when the system proxy is on.
strings.选择 PowerShell / Cmd / Bash 后点「复制命令」，粘贴到终: Pick PowerShell / Cmd / Bash, click "Copy command" and run it in a terminal so CLI tools (git / npm / curl, etc.) use the proxy temporarily.
strings.开机后自动运行无界互联。: Runs Unbound link automatically after boot.
strings.开机自启时不显示主界面，直接进入托盘。: On auto-start, skip the main window and go straight to the tray.
strings.应用启动后默认停留的页面，可选仪表盘 / 代理 / 连接 / 统计 / 日志 /: The page shown after launch: Dashboard / Proxies / Connections / Traffic / Logs / Unlock Test / Settings.
strings.应用启动时自动执行的脚本，支持 exe / bat / cmd / ps1；文件: A script run automatically at app launch: exe / bat / cmd / ps1; skipped and logged if missing.
strings.左键单击托盘图标的动作（右键固定弹出快捷面板），可选显示主窗口 / 切换系统代理: What a left-click on the tray icon does (right-click always opens the quick panel): show main window / toggle system proxy / toggle TUN mode.
strings.托盘图标随运行状态切换：常规 / 系统代理开启 / TUN 开启。每一态都可以各: The tray icon changes with status: normal / system proxy on / TUN on. Each state can use your own PNG icon instead of the built-in one; clear it anytime to restore the default.
strings.点击关闭按钮时隐藏窗口而不是退出，程序仍在后台运行。: The close button hides the window instead of quitting; the app keeps running in the background.
strings.在桌面上显示可拖动的实时网速悬浮窗。: Shows a draggable live-speed window on the desktop.
strings.开启后悬浮窗不拦截鼠标操作，点击会穿透到下层窗口。: When on, the floating window doesn't intercept the mouse; clicks pass through to windows below.
strings.内核崩溃、订阅自动更新等事件弹出系统通知。: Shows system notifications for events like core crashes and subscription auto-updates.
strings.内核异常退出时自动拉起。带防抖动限制，短时间内反复崩溃不会无限重启。: Restarts the core automatically after unexpected exits. Debounced — repeated crashes in a short time won't restart forever.
strings.应用启动后自动检查客户端新版本，发现新版本时发送系统通知。: Checks for new client versions after launch and sends a notification when one is found.
strings.切换节点后关闭旧连接，让新节点立即接管已有会话。: Closes old connections after switching nodes so the new node takes over existing sessions immediately.
strings.检测到系统代理被其他程序篡改时自动恢复，并写入应用日志。: Automatically restores system proxy settings if another program tampers with them, logging the event.
strings.点击快捷键即可录制新的组合，界面提供「恢复默认」。快捷键由系统级注册，被其他软件: Click a shortcut to record a new combination; "Restore defaults" is provided. Shortcuts register at the system level — if another app already uses one, binding fails; just pick another.
strings.分为「内核与控制」（端口与模式、内核行为、Web 控制面板）、「连接方式」（TU: Three groups: "Core and control" (ports and mode, kernel behavior, web dashboard), "Connection method" (TUN mode, DNS), and "Automation" (speed test and health, network environment).
strings.HTTP / SOCKS 混合监听端口。修改后内核自动重启。: The HTTP / SOCKS mixed listening port; the core restarts automatically after a change.
strings.控制接口端口。修改后内核自动重启。: The control API port; the core restarts automatically after a change.
strings.规则 / 全局 / 直连。「规则」按规则分流；「全局」所有流量走同一个出口；「直: Rule / Global / Direct. "Rule" routes traffic by rules; "Global" sends all traffic through one exit; "Direct" bypasses the proxy entirely.
strings.调试 / 信息 / 警告 / 错误 / 静默，影响内核日志输出的详细程度。: Debug / Info / Warning / Error / Silent; controls how detailed the core's log output is.
strings.应用启动时自动拉起内核。: Starts the core automatically when the app launches.
strings.开启后同一局域网内的其他设备可通过 <code>本机IP:混合端口</code>: When on, other devices on the same LAN can use the proxy via local-IP:mixed-port; the address is shown in the UI.
strings.开启「允许局域网连接」后，同一行会出现这个按钮；点击弹出二维码（内容为本机代理地: Appears on the same row once Allow LAN is on. Clicking it shows a QR code (with the local proxy address); when the phone and PC are on the same LAN, set the phone's Wi-Fi "Manual proxy" to that address as prompted.
strings.允许内核使用 IPv6 出站；网络环境不支持时保持关闭可提升兼容性。: Lets the core use IPv6 for outbound traffic; keep it off when your network doesn't support IPv6 for better compatibility.
strings.同一主机的多节点延迟取一致值，测速结果更稳定直观。: Multiple nodes on the same host report one consistent latency value, making test results more stable and intuitive.
strings.内置 MetaCubeXD 面板，首次打开时自动下载（约 2.5MB）。本机地址: A built-in MetaCubeXD dashboard, downloaded automatically on first open (about 2.5MB). The local address is http://127.0.0.1:9090/ui/; click "Open dashboard" to enter.
strings.开启「允许局域网连接」后，这里还会显示局域网面板地址，形如 <code>http: With "Allow LAN connections" on, a LAN dashboard address such as http://192.168.x.x:9090/ui/ also appears here, ready to copy to other devices on the same network with one click.
strings.<b>控制密钥</b>用于保护 External Controller：首次运行: The control secret protects the External Controller: randomly generated on first run and regenerable with one click; after a change the core restarts automatically, and dashboards or third-party clients using the old secret must switch to the new one.
strings.标题旁有权限标签：已获得管理员权限显示绿色「已提权」，否则显示橙色「未提权」，并: A privilege badge sits next to the title: green "Elevated" with admin rights, otherwise orange "Not elevated", along with a "Restart as administrator" button.
strings.通过虚拟网卡接管全部流量，能覆盖不认系统代理的程序（部分游戏、命令行工具）。需要: Takes over all traffic through a virtual adapter, covering programs that ignore the system proxy (some games, command-line tools). Requires admin rights.
strings.可选 Mixed / Gvisor / System。不确定时用 Mixed。: Options are Mixed / Gvisor / System. Use Mixed when unsure.
strings.开启后覆盖订阅里的 DNS 配置。: When on, overrides the DNS config from your subscription.
strings.TUN 模式推荐开启；关闭时使用 redir-host 模式。: Recommended with TUN mode; when off, redir-host mode is used.
strings.主 DNS 解析不可靠时回落使用的服务器，格式与主 DNS 一致；留空不下发。: Servers to fall back on when the main DNS is unreliable, in the same format as the main DNS; left blank, nothing is sent.
strings.每行一条「域名 IP」映射，支持 <code>#</code> 注释，随配置下发: One "domain IP" mapping per line; supports # comments and is delivered to the core with the config.
strings.按间隔自动对当前分组测速，保持延迟数据新鲜。: Automatically tests the current group at the set interval to keep latency data fresh.
strings.自动测速的时间间隔，范围 1 - 1440 分钟。: Interval for automatic latency tests, from 1 to 1440 minutes.
strings.滚动记录各节点延迟历史并在代理页展示趋势；当前节点连续测速失败时发送系统通知。: Keeps a rolling latency history per node and draws trends on the Proxies page; sends a system notification when the current node keeps failing tests.
strings.当前节点连续 <code>2</code> 次测速失败时，自动切换到备用节点；依: When the current node fails 2 latency tests in a row, it switches automatically to the fallback node; relies on Node health monitoring above. Applies only to "manual select" proxy groups — auto-test groups recover on their own inside the core.
strings.掉线切换的优先目标，下拉列出主策略组内的节点；留空时自动选择组内延迟最低的可用节: Preferred target for failover; the dropdown lists the nodes in the main proxy group. When left empty, the available node with the lowest latency in the group is chosen automatically. Shown once Automatic failover is enabled.
strings.按当前连接的 Wi-Fi 名称自动切换系统代理与运行模式，适合「到家自动开、到公: Switches the system proxy and mode automatically according to the connected Wi-Fi name — handy for "on at home, off at the office". The app checks the Wi-Fi name every 10 seconds; when it changes, the first enabled rule that matches is applied from top to bottom. Actions identical to the current state are skipped, so manual adjustments are not overridden. This feature does not change the TUN state.
strings.总开关；开启后 Wi-Fi 名称变化时自动应用下方匹配规则。: Master switch; when on, the matching rule below is applied whenever the Wi-Fi name changes.
strings.显示当前连接的网络名称（未连接 Wi-Fi 时显示「未连接 Wi-Fi」），右侧: Shows the name of the connected network ("Not connected to Wi-Fi" when there is none); the button to the right refreshes it manually.
strings.每行一条：左侧开关控制该行是否启用，依次为 Wi-Fi 名称、系统代理动作与运行: One rule per row: the switch on the left enables it, followed by the Wi-Fi name, the system-proxy action and the mode action. Names support * (any characters) and ? (a single character) wildcards, case-insensitive, e.g. Home-*. An action set to "No change" keeps the current state; other choices (system proxy: On / Off; mode: Rule / Global / Direct) are applied on a match.
strings.右上角按钮；新增一条默认启用、动作均为「不改变」的规则，补齐名称与动作后生效。: The button at the top right adds a rule that is enabled by default with all actions set to "No change"; fill in the name and actions to take effect.
strings.围绕规则与连接优化的四个实用工具：解除商店应用回环限制、更新规则数据库、配置端口: Four utilities around rules and connections: lifting the loopback restriction for Store apps, updating the rules database, setting up port-forwarding tunnels, and tidying the node list with keyword filters and replacement rules.
strings.从 Microsoft Store 安装的应用默认无法访问本机代理地址（<cod: Apps installed from the Microsoft Store can't reach the local proxy address (127.0.0.1) by default, which shows up as no network inside the app. Click "Manage apps" to open the list and flip the switch for the apps you need — on lifts the loopback restriction, off restores it. Changing loopback exemptions requires admin rights; if it fails, relaunch the app as administrator and retry.
strings.规则里的 GEOIP / GEOSITE 分流依赖四个数据库文件（<code>g: GEOIP / GEOSITE routing depends on four database files (geoip.dat, geosite.dat, geoip.metadb, GeoLite2-ASN.mmdb); the core loads them from the data directory at startup, and missing or outdated files break the corresponding rules. This section shows each file's size and update time; click "Update databases" to fetch them from the official release page in one go — on direct-connection failure an accelerated mirror is tried automatically, and if that still fails the download goes through the local proxy. Updating all files at once is a large download, so give it a moment.
strings.把本机端口转发到远端目标地址：内核在本地监听指定端口，命中后经指定出口（代理组或: Forwards a local port to a remote target: the core listens on the given local port and relays through a chosen exit (proxy group or node) to the target host — handy for mapping remote intranet services (databases, remote desktop) to your machine. Each tunnel picks a protocol (TCP / UDP / mixed), a local listen address and port, and a target address and port; with the exit left blank, traffic routes by rules. Tunnels are runtime config; the core restarts automatically after any change.
strings.生成运行时配置时对节点列表做一次统一整理，适合订阅里节点又多又杂的情况，三部分可: Applies a unified cleanup to the node list when the runtime config is generated — handy when a subscription brings too many noisy nodes. The three parts combine freely: Filter keywords removes any node whose name hits a keyword (case-insensitive); Rename rules replace text in node names in order (case-sensitive; an empty replacement deletes that piece of text); Common prefix / suffix adds a uniform prefix and suffix to every node name after all replacements.
strings.整理会连同代理组、规则与隧道等处的节点引用一并改写，不会出现改名后引用失效的问题: The cleanup also rewrites node references in proxy groups, rules and tunnels, so renamed nodes never break their references. Click "Preview" to see the result before deciding whether to enable it: how many nodes in total, how many filtered, how many renamed — preview works even while the switch is off.
strings.分为「更新与测速」（订阅、内核更新、节点测速）和「数据与日志」（配置快照、备份与: Two groups: "Updates and tests" (subscription, core update, node latency test) and "Data and logs" (config snapshots, backup and restore, app logs).
strings.<b>自动更新间隔</b>，单位小时，<b>0 表示关闭</b>，默认关闭。开启: Auto-update interval, in hours, 0 means off, off by default. Once enabled, every subscription in the list updates on schedule in the background; when done, the config reloads automatically and a system notification is sent.
strings.<b>更新后自动选优</b>默认关闭。开启后，每次订阅更新并重载配置完成时，客户: Auto-optimize after update, off by default. Once enabled, every time subscriptions finish updating and the config reloads, the client automatically tests the main proxy group and sets the lowest-latency available node as the current node (applies only to "manual select" proxy groups — auto-test groups make their own pick inside the core); the result is sent as a system notification.
strings.<b>订阅用量提醒</b>默认开启，依赖订阅源提供的流量与到期信息，共三档：<b: Profile usage alerts is on by default and relies on the traffic and expiry info provided by the subscription source. There are three tiers: Usage alert threshold (alert when used traffic reaches this percentage, default 80%, adjustable from 1 to 100), Expiration alert (alert when remaining days are at or below this value, default 3 days, 0 turns this tier off) and the "expired" alert. Each tier fires only once; after a renewal or plan reset it arms again and alerts again when the condition is met.
strings.这里显示当前内核版本，点「检查更新」查询是否有新版本。发现新版本时可一键更新，客: Shows the current core version; click "Check for updates" to see if a new one exists. When there is, update with one click — the client downloads from GitHub Releases and replaces the core.
strings.超过该时间未响应即判定为超时。: A node that doesn't respond within this time counts as timed out.
strings.每次生成运行配置前，<code>config.yaml</code> 的旧内容会: Before each runtime config is generated, the previous config.yaml is archived automatically (the latest 10 are kept). Click View snapshots to see the list; if the core won't start or the config misbehaves, roll back to the last working version in one click. Restoring writes back and hot-reloads the core immediately, archiving the current file first.
strings.快照属于应急回退手段：恢复之后，下次修改设置或重启内核时仍会按当前设置重新生成配: Snapshots are an emergency fallback: after restoring, the config is regenerated from your current settings the next time you change something or restart the core.
strings.把设置、订阅、Merge 配置与内核版本导出为一个 JSON 文件。: Exports settings, subscriptions, Merge config and the core version into a single JSON file.
strings.从备份文件恢复全部数据，会覆盖当前设置与订阅。导入前会二次确认「导入备份？」。: Restores all data from a backup file, overwriting current settings and subscriptions. A confirmation "Import backup?" appears first.
strings.把应用与内核版本、当前设置、运行配置与最近的日志打包为一个 ZIP 文件，密钥等: Packs app and core versions, current settings, runtime config and recent logs into a ZIP file, with sensitive fields such as secrets masked automatically — handy to attach to a bug report.
strings.客户端自身的运行日志会写入数据目录的 <code>logs\\app.log</: The client's own logs are written to logs\app.log in the data directory and rotate by size into archives (app.1.log, app.2.log…); click "Open log folder" to view them. They record the app's own actions (core start/stop, system proxy changes, config and updates), complementing the core's real-time logs on the Logs page — ideal for after-the-fact troubleshooting.
strings.错误 / 警告 / 信息 / 调试，控制写入日志文件的详细程度，修改即时生效。: Error / Warning / Info / Debug; controls how detailed the log files are, effective immediately.
strings.范围 16 KB - 10 MB，达到上限后自动轮转。: Range: 16 KB - 10 MB; files rotate automatically at the limit.
strings.范围 2 - 50，保留的日志文件总数，超出后删除最旧的。: Range: 2 - 50; the total number of log files kept, with the oldest deleted beyond that.
strings.范围 1 - 365，自动清理超过该天数的归档日志。: Range: 1 - 365; archives older than this are cleaned up automatically.
strings.顶部展示应用 logo 与应用名，下方列出应用版本、内核版本与数据目录。数据目录: The app logo and name sit at the top, with app version, core version and data directory listed below. The data directory is %APPDATA%\com.unboundlink.desktop, copyable with one click — back it up before migrating machines or reinstalling; click "Open folder" to view it in Explorer.
strings.页面提供「退出应用」按钮，点击后会二次确认「退出无界互联？」，这里是真正结束程序: There is an Exit app button — confirming 'Exit Unbound link?' truly ends the program. Check for updates lets you download the installer in the app and complete the upgrade automatically (it installs silently and restarts with the new version); you can cancel and download manually at any time. Help & support opens the website and the online guide. The Developer tools entry opens a built-in debugging panel — not needed for daily use. The bottom of the page reminds you that all settings are saved instantly.
strings.日常最常用的三处是：系统 → 系统代理卡片；网络 → 端口与模式里的运行模式；维: The three most-used spots: System → the system proxy card; Network → Mode under "Ports and mode"; Maintenance → Data and logs → Export backup. All of them save instantly with no extra confirmation.
strings.无界互联（Unbound link）设置：外观、系统、网络、工具、维护、关于六个: Unbound link Settings: a walkthrough of the six tabs — Appearance, System, Network, Tools, Maintenance and About — covering theme customization, ports, mode, TUN, DNS, shortcuts, app logs and backup defaults.
strings.流量统计页按天记录本机经过内核的上下行流量，用来回顾一段时间内的用量趋势。: The Traffic page records this machine's daily up and down traffic through the core, so you can review usage trends over time.
strings.它回答「这些天用了多少流量」。所有数据都来自本机内核，不由任何服务器收集，你看到: It answers "how much traffic did I use these days". All data comes from the local core — no server collects it; what you see is this computer's actual usage.
strings.页面顶部可以在四个时间范围之间切换：: The top of the page switches between four time ranges:
strings.<b>近 7 天</b>——看最近一周的用量。: Last 7 days — usage over the past week.
strings.<b>近 30 天</b>——看最近一个月的用量。: Last 30 days — usage over the past month.
strings.<b>近 90 天</b>——看最近三个月的用量。: Last 90 days — usage over the past three months.
strings.切换范围后，下方的图表与表格会同步更新。范围越短，趋势越清晰；范围越长，越适合看: After switching, the chart and table below update in sync. Shorter ranges show clearer trends; longer ranges are better for overall scale. "Last 7 days" is enough for daily checks — reach for "Last 30 days" or "Last 90 days" to see long-term usage. Switching only affects the display; no historical data is deleted.
strings.看什么、怎么看: What to look at and how
strings.页面用<b>趋势图</b>加<b>明细表格</b>两种方式同时呈现：趋势图看曲线: The page presents data two ways at once — a trend chart and a detail table: the chart shows the curve's ups and downs so you can spot high-traffic days at a glance; the table gives each day's exact numbers. The table has four columns:
strings.当天上下行合计。: Combined up and down traffic for the day.
strings.如果当前范围内还没有任何记录，页面会显示「当前范围内暂无记录」。此时把时间范围放: If the current range has no records yet, the page shows "No records in this range". Widen the range, or come back after using the app for a while.
strings.页面底部还有一块<b>应用流量</b>面板：它把流量按发起进程归集，让你看出这段: At the bottom of the page there is an App traffic panel that groups traffic by originating process, showing which app used the most bandwidth over the period. The table has five columns — app, download, upload, total and last active — sorted by total, highest first.
strings.数据由客户端在内核运行后每 15 秒采样一次连接记录并累计，只统计能识别出发起进: Data is sampled from connection records every 15 seconds while the core runs; only connections with an identifiable process are counted. The list may be empty right after start-up and fills in shortly. Totals persist across restarts. To start over, click Reset at the panel's top-right to clear all per-app totals; daily records are not affected.
strings.「应用流量」面板下方还有一块<b>按节点流量</b>面板：它把流量按连接最终走出: Below the App traffic panel there is a Node traffic panel that groups traffic by the exit node each connection finally leaves through, with direct traffic listed separately as a DIRECT row — handy for comparing how much went through the proxy and how much went direct. The table has five columns — node, download, upload, total and last active — sorted by total, highest first.
strings.数据同样由客户端在内核运行后每 15 秒采样一次并累计，重启软件不会丢失；点面板: Data is likewise sampled every 15 seconds while the core runs and accumulated; totals persist across restarts. To start over, click Reset at the panel's top-right to clear all per-node totals; daily records and App traffic are not affected.
strings.数据由客户端在运行期间持续记录，并落盘到数据目录：按天记录写入 <code>tr: Data is recorded continuously while the client runs and stored in the data directory: daily records in traffic_history.json, per-app traffic in app_traffic.json and per-node traffic in node_traffic.json. Therefore history is kept after a restart and is not lost when you exit. All these files are maintained automatically by the client — no manual editing needed.
strings.统计的是「经过内核的流量」: Only traffic through the core is counted
strings.只有走内核的流量才会被计入。直连且未经过内核的流量不计入，所以统计值可能小于网卡: Only traffic that goes through the core is counted. Direct connections that bypass the core aren't included, so the totals may be lower than the adapter's actual usage.
strings.按天记录没有独立的清空按钮，可用「设置 → 维护 → 备份与恢复」的导入备份功能: Daily records have no dedicated clear button — you can overwrite them indirectly by importing a backup under Settings → Maintenance → Backup & restore. Per-app and per-node totals can be cleared with Reset at each panel's top-right.
strings.无界互联（Unbound link）流量统计使用说明：按天查看经过内核的上下行流: Unbound link Traffic guide: daily up and down traffic through the core, plus cumulative usage by app and by node.
strings.下面按「现象 → 原因 → 处理」列出常见问题。每条都给出具体操作路径，按顺序做: Common problems below follow Symptom → Cause → Fix, each with concrete steps — just work through them in order.
strings.<b>现象</b>：浏览器无法打开任何网页。: Symptom: the browser can't open any page.
strings.<b>原因</b>：系统代理残留、DNS 缓存异常或网络协议栈状态不对。: Cause: leftover system proxy settings, a bad DNS cache or an unhealthy network stack.
strings.<b>处理</b>：先打开「网络体检」看前几项结果；再用「断网急救箱」的「一键急: Fix: open Diagnostics and check the first few results; then run "One-click rescue" in the network rescue kit (reset system proxy + flush DNS cache, no admin rights needed). If that still doesn't help, follow the on-screen prompt to reset the network stack — that requires admin rights and takes effect after a reboot.
strings.<b>现象</b>：能上网，但流量没有走代理。: Symptom: the internet works, but traffic doesn't go through the proxy.
strings.<b>原因</b>：运行模式被改为全局或直连；系统代理未开启；内核未运行。: Cause: the mode was switched to Global or Direct; the system proxy is off; the core isn't running.
strings.<b>处理</b>：打开「设置 → 网络」，检查运行模式是否为「规则」（选「全局: Fix: open Settings → Network and check the mode is "Rule" (choosing "Global" or "Direct" changes behavior); open Settings → System → System proxy and check it's on; then confirm the core is running via the core status on the Dashboard or in Diagnostics.
strings.<b>现象</b>：浏览器正常，但某些程序没有走代理，Microsoft Sto: Symptom: the browser works, but some programs don't use the proxy — and apps from the Microsoft Store can't open pages at all.
strings.<b>原因</b>：这是系统代理的天然限制，部分程序不读取系统代理设置；商店应用: Cause: this is the inherent limitation of system proxies — some programs don't read the setting; Store apps are also subject to the Windows loopback restriction, which blocks access to the local address (127.0.0.1) by default.
strings.<b>处理</b>：商店应用到「设置 → 工具 → UWP 应用工具」为它打开开: Fix: for Store apps, open Settings → Tools → UWP app tool and flip the switch to lift the loopback restriction (needs admin rights); for other programs switch to TUN mode (see Settings → Network → TUN mode), or bind the process to a chosen line with App Routing.
strings.<b>现象</b>：所有节点测速都超时。: Symptom: every node tests as timed out.
strings.<b>原因</b>：节点暂时不可用，或订阅已过期、内容陈旧。: Cause: the nodes are temporarily unavailable, or the subscription has expired or is stale.
strings.<b>处理</b>：先在「代理节点」点「全部测速」；检查订阅是否过期，到「订阅管: Fix: first click "Test all" on the Proxies page; check whether the subscription has expired and click the "Traffic" button on its card under Profiles to refresh the info; then check the "direct exit / proxy exit" and "current node" conclusions in Diagnostics; you can also click "Update" for the subscription on the Profiles page. To clear useless timed-out nodes, turn on the "Hide timed-out" switch at the top of the Proxies page.
strings.<b>现象</b>：内核无法监听，提示端口冲突。: Symptom: the core can't listen; a port conflict is reported.
strings.<b>原因</b>：默认端口被其它程序占用。: Cause: the default port is taken by another program.
strings.<b>处理</b>：「网络体检」的「端口监听」会提示是哪个端口被占用；到「设置: Fix: the "port listening" check in Diagnostics shows which port is taken; change the mixed proxy port or the control port under Settings → Network → Ports and mode — the core restarts automatically after changes.
strings.<b>原因</b>：订阅链接不可访问，或当前网络不通。: Cause: the subscription URL is unreachable, or the current network is down.
strings.<b>处理</b>：确认订阅链接可访问；到「运行日志」查看错误行；网络不通时先用: Fix: confirm the subscription URL is reachable; check the error lines under Logs; if the network is down, use Diagnostics to locate the problem first.
strings.<b>现象</b>：打开「启用 TUN」没有生效，权限标签显示橙色「未提权」。: Symptom: turning on "Enable TUN" has no effect, and the privilege badge shows an orange "Not elevated".
strings.<b>原因</b>：当前进程没有管理员权限，或安装目录被占用。: Cause: the current process lacks admin rights, or the install directory is in use.
strings.<b>处理</b>：到「设置 → 网络 → TUN 模式」点「以管理员身份重启」: Fix: go to Settings → Network → TUN mode and click "Restart as administrator", confirm the UAC prompt and retry; also make sure the install directory isn't in use.
strings.<b>现象</b>：修改设置后行为没有变化。: Symptom: changing a setting doesn't change the behavior.
strings.<b>原因</b>：涉及内核的改动需要重载或重启内核；或配置生成失败。: Cause: core-related changes need a reload or restart of the core; or config generation failed.
strings.<b>处理</b>：涉及内核的改动（端口、TUN、DNS）会自动重载或重启内核；: Fix: core-related changes (ports, TUN, DNS) reload or restart the core automatically; if nothing changes, check Logs for config errors and, if needed, check the Merge override or extension script under Profiles — a syntax error makes config generation fail.
strings.<b>现象</b>：需要迁移电脑或重装系统。: Symptom: you need to migrate to a new machine or reinstall Windows.
strings.<b>原因</b>：数据目录在系统盘的用户目录下，重装会丢失。: Cause: the data directory lives under the user folder on the system drive and is lost on reinstall.
strings.<b>处理</b>：数据目录在 <code>%APPDATA%\\com.unb: Fix: the data directory is %APPDATA%\com.unboundlink.desktop. Before migrating or reinstalling, open Settings → Maintenance → Backup and restore → Export backup, then restore it in the new environment with "Import backup". When you need help troubleshooting, click "Export diagnostics" first and attach the ZIP to your report.
strings.<b>现象</b>：内核状态一直不是运行中。: Symptom: the core status never shows Running.
strings.<b>原因</b>：程序安装目录不完整，内核 sidecar 缺失或损坏。: Cause: the install directory is incomplete — the core sidecar is missing or damaged.
strings.<b>处理</b>：确认程序安装目录完整（内核是随安装包分发的 sidecar: Fix: make sure the install directory is complete (the core ships as a sidecar program with the installer); check Logs for errors; go to Settings → Maintenance → Core update and click "Check for updates" to re-fetch the core.
strings.看「仪表盘」的内核状态。: Check the core status on the Dashboard.
strings.跑「网络体检」，先看前 4 项。: Run Diagnostics and check the first 4 items.
strings.检查运行模式与系统代理。: Check the mode and the system proxy.
strings.检查订阅是否需要更新。: Check whether the subscription needs updating.
strings.问题难以定位时，点「设置 → 维护 → 备份与恢复 → 导出诊断信息」，把 ZI: If the problem is hard to pin down, click Settings → Maintenance → Backup and restore → Export diagnostics and attach the ZIP to your report.
strings.无界互联（Unbound link）故障排查：断网、代理不生效、节点超时、端口占: Unbound link Troubleshooting: symptoms, causes and fixes for no network, the proxy not taking effect, timed-out nodes, port conflicts, TUN failures and more.
strings.解锁测试 — 无界互联 使用手册: Unlock Test — Unbound link User Guide
strings.解锁测试会经当前出口依次访问 18 个常用服务，给出「解锁 / 部分解锁 / 未: Unlock Test visits 18 popular services through the current exit and reports Unlocked / Partial / Blocked / Failed for each, so you can tell whether this route can stream and use AI tools.
strings.「换了新节点，Netflix 还能看吗？」「ChatGPT 突然登不上了？」——: "I switched to a new node — can I still watch Netflix?" "ChatGPT suddenly won't sign in?" Questions like these do not need a website-by-website check. This page tests all 18 services in one pass and reports the results without delay. Requests leave through the local mixed port — the same proxy path your daily traffic takes — so what you see is the real result of the current exit node; switch to another route and the outcome can be completely different.
strings.<b>确认出口</b>：页头「出口节点」行有两个下拉框——先选分组、再选节点，可: Pick the exit: the "Exit node" row at the top has two dropdowns — pick a group, then a node; you can switch right here, and each node shows its latency;
strings.<b>开始测试</b>：点右上角「测试全部」并发检测 18 项；也可以只点某张卡: Start a test: click "Test all" at the top right to check all 18 in parallel, or click the refresh icon on a single card to test just that service;
strings.<b>读结果</b>：页头副标题实时汇总「解锁 N · 部分 N · 已测 N/: Read the results: the subtitle summarizes "Unlocked N · Partial N · Tested N/18" in real time, and each card shows a status badge and a short note.
strings.还没测过。点卡片右上角的刷新图标即可单独检测。: Not tested yet. Click the refresh icon on the card to run a single check.
strings.该服务在当前出口完全可用。: The service is fully available through the current exit.
strings.能访问，但内容有限。典型是 Netflix 的「仅自制剧可看」。: Reachable, but with limited content — the classic case is Netflix showing only its own productions.
strings.明确不可用，详情里会给出 HTTP 状态码或地区提示。: Clearly unavailable; the detail line shows the HTTP status code or the region notice.
strings.请求本身没有完成（超时、代理不通等），<b>不代表服务不可用</b>。先检查内核: The request itself did not complete (timeout, proxy unreachable, etc.) — this does not mean the service is unavailable. Check the core and node status first, then test again.
strings.每项检测都经本机混合端口发出请求，模拟浏览器 User-Agent，单次请求超时: Every check sends requests through the local mixed port with a browser User-Agent and a 12-second timeout. Each service is judged differently:
strings.<b>Netflix</b>：用两部剧交叉验证——先访问一部原创剧，返回 200: Netflix: two titles are cross-checked — an original series first, and only if it returns 200, a non-original title. Both reachable means Unlocked; only the original means Partial; otherwise Blocked.
strings.<b>Disney+ / Prime Video / Spotify / Tik: Disney+ / Prime Video / Spotify / TikTok: the home page loads and shows no "not available in your region" notice — Unlocked.
strings.<b>Hulu / HBO Max</b>：被重定向到区域提示页，或页面出现限制: Hulu / HBO Max: a redirect to a region notice page, or restricted-content text on the page, means Blocked.
strings.<b>ChatGPT Web</b>：返回 403 判为地区不支持；<b>Cha: ChatGPT Web: a 403 response means the region is unsupported; ChatGPT iOS probes a long-stable mobile status endpoint instead.
strings.<b>Bilibili</b>：通过站内接口读取出口在 B 站侧的地区判定——中: Bilibili: an in-site API reports how Bilibili sees the exit region — mainland China gets the full catalogue, while Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan and overseas regions are partially restricted.
strings.<b>Claude / Copilot / Gemini / X / 爱奇艺 /: Claude / Copilot / Gemini / X / iQIYI / Tencent Video / NetEase Cloud Music: home page reachability; region limits show up as a 403 or a redirect to a notice page.
strings.共 18 项，覆盖海外流媒体、AI 服务与国内平台：: 18 services in total, covering overseas streaming, AI services and China-side platforms:
strings.原创剧 + 非原创剧双验证，可识别「仅自制剧」。: Original + non-original title cross-check; detects "own productions only".
strings.主页可达性与地区限制提示。: Home page reachability and region notice.
strings.Premium 订阅页的地区可用性。: Region availability of the Premium subscription page.
strings.移动端状态接口，长期稳定的检测点。: Mobile status endpoint, a long-stable check target.
strings.主页可达性，403 判为地区不支持。: Home page reachability; a 403 means the region is unsupported.
strings.地区不支持时会被重定向到 Google 帮助页。: Redirects to a Google help page when the region is unsupported.
strings.站内接口地区判定（大陆 / 港澳台 / 境外）。: In-site API region check (mainland / HK-Macao-Taiwan / overseas).
strings.解锁测试测的不是「这个服务存不存在」，而是「经当前这条线路访问它，此刻是什么结果: Unlock Test does not ask "does this service exist" but "what happens right now when I reach it through this route". Results reflect the exit as of the moment they were measured — retest after switching nodes.
strings.无界互联（Unbound link）解锁测试使用说明：18 项流媒体与 AI 服: Unbound link Unlock Test guide: unlock checks for 18 streaming and AI services, how to read the four results, and how the checks work.
